english_text: The Orthling led the colonists of Beinland against King Volbjorn during the wars of unification. After their defeat they bowed to the inevitable, and offered their chief's daughter, Asgotha, as bride to the king's younger and far more popular brother Surnir. But the marriage, despite its inauspicious origins, turned out well. Asgotha was a shield maiden, and the couple fought side-by-side in battles, up until the day that Surnir was slain in a skirmish with the Sturgians. The new king Halthdar has confirmed her as jarl of Beinland, but many of her kinsmen chaff under the humiliation of Skylfing rule.
chinese_text: 奥特尔家族在统一战争中领导贝恩兰殖民者反抗沃尔比约恩国王。战败后，他们向不可避免的命运低头，将首领的女儿阿丝葛莎许配给国王更年轻、更受欢迎的弟弟苏尼尔。尽管这桩婚姻的起源并不吉利，但结果却很好。阿丝葛莎是一名盾女，这对夫妻并肩作战，直到有一天苏尼尔在与斯特吉亚人的小规模冲突中被杀。新国王哈尔达尔任命她为贝恩兰的雅尔，但她的众多族人却在许尔夫家族的统治下饱受屈辱。

english_text: Were Halthdar the Golden a petty chieftain or jarl, he would no doubt be beloved of all the warriors who followed him into battle and sat at his feast-table afterwards, to be showered with praise and rings. But he is a king, in a land that is still unhappy to be a kingdom. He is blamed by his jarls for the sins of his father, Volbjorn the Hungry, who created the Nordvyg with blood and trickery, and many long to return to the old days when they answered to no one.
chinese_text: 若“金发”哈尔达尔仅是一位小酋长或领主，他无疑会受到所有战士的爱戴，这些战士跟随他征战沙场，战后与他共宴，接受他的赞美和赏赐。然而，他是一位国王，统治着一片仍不甘愿成为王国的土地。他的雅尔们将他父亲“饿人”沃尔比约恩的罪过归咎于他，沃尔比约恩用鲜血与诡计建立了诺德维格，许多人渴望回到过去那个无需听命于任何人的时代。

english_text: Grykka Half-an-Ear came from a poor offshoot of the Kjoldings, and was little thought-of until the night that his uncle the jarl and his followers were trapped in their mead-hall by unknown warriors and the roof set alight. His hasty confirmation as jarl by the old king Volbjorn, left little doubt that he was the culprit, and had been suborned by the ruthless unifier of the Nordvyg. Despite this, or perhaps because of it, he is viewed with suspicion by Volbjorn's son and heir Halthdar.
chinese_text: “半耳”圭卡出身于肖尔德家族的一个贫寒分支，在他的雅尔叔叔及其随从被不明身份的战士们困在蜜酒大厅并点燃了屋顶的那一夜前，他一直不被人放在眼里。老国王沃尔比约恩匆忙确认了他的雅尔身份，这让人几乎认定他就是罪魁祸首，并且是被狡诈无情的诺德维格统一派收买了。尽管如此，又或许正因如此，沃尔比约恩的儿子兼继承人哈尔达尔一直对他忌惮三分。

english_text: Ilrika was the wife of Volbjorn the Hungry, first King of the Nordvyg. She was a caretaker of a woodland shrine, the keeper of secret rituals, and every bit as ambitious as her husband. When Volbjorn died, Ilrika's machinations ensured that her son, Halthdar, had no serious rivals for the throne. When his rule was secure, she soon died - or so the royal household claimed. Others say she returned to the woods, and some claim to see her wandering on moonless nights, ensuring none dare challenge the dynasty.
chinese_text: 伊丽卡是“饿人”沃尔比约恩的妻子——后者是诺德维格的第一位国王。她是一位森林圣地的守护者，掌握着秘密仪式，和她的丈夫一样野心勃勃。当沃尔比约恩去世后，伊丽卡的运筹帷幄确保了她的儿子哈尔达尔在争夺王位时没有劲敌。当他的统治稳固后，她便很快去世了——至少王室是这样宣称的。然而，也有人说她回到了森林里，甚至有人声称在无月的夜晚看到她四处游荡，确保无人敢挑战这个王朝。

english_text: Many over the years have styled themselves King of the Nordvyg, but Volbjorn the Hungry is the first for whom it was more than an empty title. As a young man he served the Empire as a mercenary, accumulating a huge horde of gold. With it, he returned home to transform his jarldom into a kingdom. Some who resisted him were defeated in battle, others were bought, and others found out that someone whom they trusted could be bought. It is whispered that, when Volbjorn was on his deathbed, he ordered himself sealed alive inside his barrow with his gold, so that greed and sorcery could transform him, and he could count it every night.
chinese_text: 多年来，许多人都自称为诺德维格之王，但“饿人”沃尔比约恩是第一个让这个头衔成为实地实权的人。年轻时，他曾作为雇佣兵为帝国效力，积累了巨额财富。带着这些财富，他回到家乡，将自己的土地从雅尔领扩张为王国。一些反抗他的人被击败，另一些被收买，还有一些发现他们所信任的人被收买了。据传，沃尔比约恩临终时下令，将自己与黄金一起活埋在他的墓冢中，以便贪婪与巫术能将他转化，让他每晚都能清点自己的财富。

english_text: The wealth of the Nordvyg comes from the sea. The longships sail south bearing walrus ivory, whale oil, and fish to sell - then return to the fjords laden with plunder and captives. Until recently, southerners could take comfort that the half-dozen so-called "kings" of the Nordvyg each controlled little more than a shrine or slave market surrounded by a wooden palisade. A generation ago, however, Volbjorn the Hungry returned from a decade in the empire's Vaegar Guard with riches that he used to bend the northland to his will, forcing its chieftains to pledge themselves as his jarls. Today his sons rule, and though the bond holding this new realm together are weak, they may strengthen them by turning their vassals' attentions to conquest.
chinese_text: 诺德维格的财富来自海洋。长船载着海象牙、鲸油和鱼类向南航行，出售货物后，再满载战利品和俘虏返回峡湾。直到最近，南方人还能庆幸地认为诺德维格的那六七个所谓“国王”，所控制的不过是一座被木栅栏环绕的神庙或奴隶市场。然而，一代人之前，“饿人”沃尔比约恩从帝国的维吉亚卫队服役十年归来，带着财富，迫使北地的部落领袖们宣誓效忠，尊他为北境的雅尔之主。如今，他的儿子们统治着这片土地，尽管维系这个新王国的纽带脆弱，但他们可能会通过将附庸的注意力转向征服来加强这种纽带。

english_text: Ulikshorn lies beside the Jumne River as it cuts through the hills known as the Iltanhindrun, named because they posed a barrier to mountain tribes just across the frontiers. Those peoples were pushed farther south and absorbed into the Khuzait confederacy, leaving a considerable land trafficked only by nomadic herdsmen and raiders. The region is rich in wheat, barley and other grains.
chinese_text: 于利克舍恩坐落在朱姆内河畔，这条河流穿过被称为“伊勒坦辛德伦”的山峦地区。这些山区之所以得名，是因为它们曾是边境另一侧山区部落的天然屏障。这些部落后来被进一步向南驱赶，并被库赛特联盟所吞并，留下了大片只有游牧民和袭击者往来的土地。该地区盛产小麦、大麦及其他谷物。

english_text: Rovalatys, in the mountains of the Ebor Peninsula, was never fully an imperial town. Nordic migrants, drawn to the region by rumors of riches to be made prospecting for silver or hunting for furs, long outnumbered Calradians even before the Vlandian invasion. The Vlandians too recognized its potential, and despite its harsh winters this land is among the more populous regions of the kingdom, with bountiful fields in the valleys of the mountains feeding the constant flow of settlers from the south drawn here by their hunger for wealth.
chinese_text: 位于埃博半岛群山之中的罗瓦拉堤斯，从未成为一座彻头彻尾的帝国城镇。诺德移民对当地可以开采银矿和猎取野兽毛皮的谣言信以为真，于是大规模涌入该地区，即便在瓦兰迪亚人入侵前夕，此地的诺德人也比卡拉德人要多得多。瓦兰迪亚人也意识到了这里的潜力，因为尽管冬季气候恶劣，这片土地仍是整个王国人口最为稠密的地区。山谷中的大片农田供养着自南方而来，希望于此地觅得一桶金的迁居者们。

english_text: Chornad in the Neurval Valley, beneath the Biscan Hills. The villagers of this region, like many in the central Vlandian kingdom, specializing in raising pigs on the plentiful acorns that fall from the region's oak trees.
chinese_text: 绍尔纳地处纳尔谷，正好坐落于比斯坎山脚下。当地村民和瓦兰迪亚王国中部的许多居民一样，专门利用当地橡树落下的丰富橡果来养猪。

english_text: Tor Melina lies on a flank of the Morcomb, a valley at the northwestern edge of the Battanian realm. The slopes, well-drained and exposed to the sun, produce a fine crop of wheat.
chinese_text: 托·梅利纳位于巴旦尼亚王国西北边缘的摩康谷一侧。这里阳光充足、排水良好的山坡盛产优质小麦。

english_text: Hanekhy sits atop a northern spur of the Akkan Hills. Each day, the villagers climb down winding paths to tend their wheatfields in the plains below.
chinese_text: 哈内希坐落于阿克坎丘陵北部的一处山嘴上。村民们每日沿着蜿蜒的小径下山，去照料山下平原上的麦田。

english_text: Hakarshus was the first settlement on the northern coast of Beinland. Its founder, Hakar, harbored a resentment towards authority that was fierce even by local standards. His descendants have become walrus hunters and whalers, venturing to the far north, away from kings and jarls and taxes, in search of their quarry.
chinese_text: 哈卡许斯是贝恩兰北部海岸的第一个定居点。其创立者，哈卡，对权威的憎恨即使以当地的标准来看，多少也是有点极端了。他的后代成为鲸鱼和海象猎手，冒险到遥远的北方，远离国王、贵族和税收，只为寻找猎物。

english_text: Varagos sits on the Aris River, which flows into the deep pool known as the Ophthys. Landowners here have planted mulberry bushes on the warm hillsides, on which they cultivate silkworms.
chinese_text: 瓦拉戈斯坐落在阿里斯河畔，河流由此汇入深邃的俄佛堤斯湖。这里的土地所有者们在温暖的山坡上种植了桑树，用以养殖桑蚕。

english_text: Ostrif sits on a plateau on the eastern end of the Nordvyg coast. The villagers raise cattle on the grassy pastures above the sea-cliffs.
chinese_text: 奥斯特里夫坐落在诺德维格海岸东端的一个高原上。村民们在海崖上方的草地牧场养殖牛群。

english_text: Hertogea lies in the shadow of Mount Erithrys. Villagers grow olives on the slopes leading up the mountain. This region is home to a number of hot springs as well as caves that smell of the vapors of the earth. One of them - it is known not which - was home to a Palaic oracle who delivered a series of prophecies about the rise and eventual fall of the Empire. Imperial scholars with a mystical bent hotly debate which of the cryptic verses are authentic, and which ones are later inventions.
chinese_text: 赫托该亚坐落于厄里特律斯山的荫蔽之下。村民们沿山麓斜坡种植橄榄树。这片区域分布着多处温泉，以及弥漫着大地气息的岩洞群。其中某个洞穴——具体位置已不可考——曾是帕拉人的神谕所所在地，该神谕所曾发布过一系列关于帝国兴衰的预言。对此，帝国学者中崇尚神秘主义的一派激烈争论着哪些晦涩诗句确属神谕原文，哪些又是后世伪作。

english_text: The tale of Sarpea of Onira is one of the epic poems of the eastern frontier. Like many, it seems written to justify the Empire's conquest. Sarpea, a senator's daughter, was seized by a Palaic chieftain and carried to his citadel here. When the imperial armies appeared before its walls years later to rescue her, she begged them to retreat for the sake of her infant son, whom her fearsome husband had threatened to hurl from the walls instead of allowing him to be captured and raised by his mother's people. The legions withdrew, so the story says, but the boy grew into a warrior who joined the Empire and slew his father. The town is now the main trading center for the herders and miners of the eastern Tanaetic plain.
chinese_text: 俄尼拉的萨尔培娅传说是东部边境的史诗之一。和其他的许多史诗一样，它似乎是为正义化帝国的征服而著。萨尔培娅是一位元老的女儿，她被一位帕拉酋长掳走，带回到他在此处的要塞。几年后，当帝国军队兵临城下来解救她时，她请求他们看在自己尚在襁褓中的儿子的份上撤军。因为她那可怕的丈夫威胁着宁把孩子扔下城墙，都不会交给孩子母亲的同族抚养。故事中说军团撤退了，但那男孩成长为一名战士后加入了帝国，并弑杀了自己的生父。如今，这里是东部平原的养马业中心。

english_text: Gauksdal sits on the middle reaches of the Jumne, the river that the Khuzaits call the Karakaz. This stretch of valley is named in commemoration of Gauk, a local homesteader, who escaped a Khuzait ambush by swimming across the river in spring when it was choked with floating ice. Villagers now plant flax by the river's weedy shallows.
chinese_text: 盖于斯达尔坐落在朱姆内河的中游，这条河被库赛特人称之为喀拉卡孜河。这片河谷以本地定居者盖于命名，他在春季河面被浮冰堵塞时通过游泳成功逃过了库赛特人的伏击。如今，村民们在河边杂草丛生的浅滩种植亚麻。

english_text: The clifftop village of Skarthness is known for its intrepid mariners. While most of their neighbors are content to fish nearby banks, Skarthnessers voyage seasonally to the far north of Beinland on walrus hunts, bringing back valuable ivory.
chinese_text: 斯卡特奈斯悬崖边的村庄以其勇敢的水手而闻名。虽然大多数居住在附近的人满足于在河岸捕鱼，但斯卡特奈斯人每年季节性地前往贝恩兰北部进行海象狩猎，带回珍贵的象牙。

english_text: Pen Cannoc sits on a promontory overlooking the Etircomb pass as it plunges from the Uchalion plateau into the Vlandian lowlands. Legends speak of the water-nymphs who live in springs that form in the cliffside, luring travellers and invaders to their deaths, except on those rare occasions when they fall in love with a hero and grant him victory and blessings. Certainly the people of this region have learned respect for the perils of the Etircomb, where a small misstep on slippery stone can cast one off a precipice into the gorge below.
chinese_text: 彭·坎诺克坐落于高山之巅，注视着特朗河自乌卡利翁高原奔腾涌向瓦兰迪亚的低地。据传说，水之女神生活在山岩之下的暗池里面，诱惑着旅行者和闯入者踏入死地，只有很少的情况下女神会和一位英雄坠入爱河，赠予他胜利和赐福。当然，这些渔人口里的传言只是出于对特朗河上游的敬畏，因为在滑腻的石子上着错一步脚，人就会掉落到湍急的水里。

english_text: Vinela on the landward side of the Epiric Hills, facing the Gavys River. Early morning sea-mists that come up the Gavys valley from the Perassic, together with the hot sun of midday, allow the growing of wine grapes.
chinese_text: 维内拉位于埃皮尔山脉的向陆一侧，面朝伽维斯河。清晨从珀拉斯海沿伽维斯河谷涌来的海雾，配合正午的灼热阳光，为葡萄种植提供了理想条件。

english_text: Erzenur sits alongside the east branch of the Tiagys River. It is known in the local dialect as the Kizil Teyagh from the strong reddish tint in the iron-rich sediments borne in its currents. Villagers will often divert the waters to wash away soil and expose new seams of ore.
chinese_text: 埃泽努尔坐落在蒂亚具斯河东支流旁。当地人称该河为“克孜勒·帖牙合”，因其富含铁元素的沉积物使水流呈现出浓烈的红褐色。村民常引河水冲刷土壤，以暴露新的矿脉。

english_text: Nifdal is named for the dense mists that rise in the morning from the nearby Jumne river. The villagers here raise shaggy-haired cattle bred to withstand the bitter winters.
chinese_text: 尼芙达尔因清晨从附近朱姆内河升腾而起的浓雾而得名。这里的村民饲养着毛发蓬松的牛，这些牛经过繁育，能够抵御严酷的冬季。

english_text: Myzea gives its name to the Myzead, the mountainous highlands of the eastern Empire. This region is the old stomping grounds of the senator Litos, who brought the Palaic tribes here into the Empire relatively peacefully by offering them protection against raiders from the steppes. When he fell afoul of his rivals in the Senate, however, he tried to organize them into a rival 'barbarian' republic modelled on the ancient Calradian version. The empire snuffed it out, but the people here, now thoroughly Calradicized, still harbor an attachment to the old republican system and its partisans.
chinese_text: 密泽亚的名字来源于密泽亚德，帝国中东部富饶的山峦之乡。这片地区曾是元老李图的留恋之地，他率领着帕拉人以相对和平的方式加入帝国，换取了免受草原掠袭者侵扰的保护。然而，当他在元老院被对手打压失势后，他试图将部落民组织起来，效仿卡拉德古制建立一个能够分庭抗礼的“蛮族”共和国。这一行动当然被迅速掐灭了，但是这里的人民——尽管如今已经彻底卡拉德化——仍对旧共和体制与共和派有着天然的好感。

english_text: Ataconia sits near the headwaters of the Aris river in the piedmont of the Dryatic Mountains. The hills, rich with oak trees, are ideal for the raising of acorn-eating swine.
chinese_text: 阿塔科尼亚位于德律亚山麓的阿里斯河源头附近。这里遍布橡树的山丘，非常适合饲养以橡子为食的猪。

english_text: Korsyas sits on the bay that the Sturgians call the Battanian Sea. Villagers here specialize in hunting blackfish, minke and other smaller whales that breed here in the protected waters.
chinese_text: 科尔夏斯坐落于被斯特吉亚人称为巴旦尼亚海的海湾边。这里的村民专长于捕捞黑鱼、小须鲸及其他在受保护水域繁殖的小型鲸类。

english_text: Dorstrand overlooks a grim gravel beach in the western end of the Nordvyg. Villagers earn their living by fishing cod, char and other arctic fish, including a variety of deepwater sharks whose flesh must be fermented before it is eaten.
chinese_text: 多斯特兰俯瞰着诺德维格西端一片阴沉的砾石海滩。村民靠捕捞鳕鱼、北极红点鲑和其他北极鱼类为生，其中包括各种深海鲨鱼，这些鲨鱼的肉必须发酵后才能食用。

english_text: Meroc overlooks a cove in the Biscan Coast. Like many villages in this region, its inhabitants fish nearby banks for mullet and cod for their day-to-day meals, while its bolder seafarers go much further into the western ocean to hunt more lucrative quarry, in particular whales.
chinese_text: 梅罗克俯瞰着比斯坎海岸的一处小海湾。与这一地区的许多村庄一样，居民们日常靠捕捞附近海域的鲻鱼和鳕鱼为生，而更为胆大的水手则会更加深入西部的深海，猎取利润更丰厚的猎物，尤其是鲸类。

english_text: Varnovapol, which sits beneath the Chertyg Mountains on the crystal waters of Lake Laconis, has the dubious honor of being perhaps the most-often conquered city in Calradia. Originally it was a colony of the Empire, infamous as a place of exile for dissident senators, before it was seized by Nords as a base to expand their influence into the Sturgian fur trade. It was taken by the Alkit tribe from the eastern steppe and briefly served as the capital of a small khanate, before finally falling to the fierce Ormidoving clan.
chinese_text: 瓦尔诺瓦波尔位于车尔特格山脚下，波光粼粼的拉科尼斯湖畔，是卡拉迪亚大陆上被征服次数最多的城市，还因此出了名。它原本是帝国的殖民地，唱反调的元老们常常被流放至此。之后诺德人夺取了它，用于扩大其在斯特吉亚毛皮贸易的影响力。在那之后，来自东方草原的阿契特部攻占了此地，并短暂将其立为一个小汗国的都城。最终这座城市落入到凶猛的奥米多夫家族手里。

english_text: The villagers of Holarsver fish the eastern Byalic Sea, where the runoff from the streams creates a brackish mix of saltwater and fresh. Here the catch consists of salmon, sea-trout and bottom-dwelling fish like flounder, caught in wicker traps.
chinese_text: 霍拉斯韦尔村民在比亚里海的东部区域捕鱼，洋流在那里分出径流，造成了咸淡水混合的环境。在这里，他们的捕获包括鲑鱼、海鲟和底栖鱼类，如比目鱼，这些鱼都是用柳条陷阱捕获的。

english_text: The seafaring village of Tharklif lies at the foot of a cliff overlooking the Byalic Sea. The inhabitants fish local stocks of char and cod, but are most known for their long-ranging voyages in pursuit of right whales and bowheads which migrate through these waters.
chinese_text: 塔克利夫是一个位于悬崖脚下的海滨渔村，注视着比亚里海。村民捕捞当地的鳟鱼和鳕鱼，但更为人知的是他们追逐在这些水域迁徙的露脊鲸和弓头鲸的远洋航行。

english_text: The villagers of Kvol include the descendants of refugees and malcontents from across Calradia, seeking isolation in the cold northern forests. They grow barley for sustenance, but many far afield for seasonal work. Some join Nords and others on their walrus hunts in the far north.
chinese_text: 克沃尔的村民由卡拉迪亚各地的逃亡者与不满者的后裔组成，他们选择在寒冷的北方森林中寻求与世隔绝的生活。他们种植大麦维持生计，但许多人会远赴他乡从事季节性劳作。部分村民会与诺德人结伴，前往极北之地参与海象狩猎活动。

english_text: Carphenion lies in the rolling hills east of Mount Erithrys. On summer nights the hills above the village are dotted with the fires of cattle herders, taking their animals to graze on the upland pastures.
chinese_text: 卡耳斐尼翁位于厄里特律斯山以东的连绵丘陵之中。夏夜里，村子上方的山丘上星星点点地散布着牧牛人的篝火，他们正赶着牲口去高处的草场吃草。

english_text: Husn Fulq, Fulq's citadel, stands at the landward side of the Jabal al-Kals, the hills of bitterness, that divide the Aserai lands from the Empire. Fulq, also known as Phalcos, was a dark-faced mercenary chieftain who came from lands far to the south. He founded a fortress here and then parlayed its strategic location into a fortune, taking bribes from the Empire and then from the Aserai to switch sides. After 20 years of playing both sides back and forth he sailed home in a ship laden with gold, but many clans of the Aserai proudly claim descent from him, and the 'Tricks of Fulq' are a staple of many a bazaar storyteller's repetoire.
chinese_text: 侯森·富勒格位于卡尔得亚的东南边缘，卡尔得亚是一片由河流和咸水潟湖构成的网络，它将帝国和阿塞莱的土地相连。富勒格，又名法耳科斯，是一位来自于极南之地的黑面孔雇佣兵酋长。他在此地建立了一座堡垒，又利用堡垒的战略位置发了财，从帝国和阿塞莱两边收取贿赂，并随时准备着选边站队。在玩了将近二十年的换队游戏之后，他驾着一艘满载黄金的船驶回了家，但许多阿塞莱的氏族仍然骄傲地自称是他的后裔。“富勒格的鬼点子”也成为了许多集市说书人口中经久不衰的故事桥段。

english_text: Makeb sits on the northern tip of Lake Tanaesis, Tanaz in the steppe tongue. This city has long been ruled by petty khans and shahs, who collect tolls from traders forced to haul their boats around the rapids. The last of those rulers was beheaded by Urkhun himself after he refused a demand of tribute, after which the ruling family of the Khuzaits seized this town for themselves.
chinese_text: 马凯布位于草原民族称之为达那孜的塔奈西斯湖的北端。这座城市拱卫着喀拉卡孜河汇入湖泊时形成的大瀑布。该城长期被小汗和小沙阿们统治，他们派遣纤夫拖着商船渡过湍流，并收取过路费。然而，因为拒绝纳贡，该城的末代统治者被兀儿浑汗亲手枭首。自那以后，这座城市就被库赛特的统治者家族亲自掌控。

english_text: Thralathorp was settled by fugitives and runaways from various estates in the Jumne valley. It lies far to the east of the main Nord settlements, on the edge of the steppe. Isolation, freezing winters and frequent Khuzait raids ensure that there are few who would bother disputing their title. The people here make what money they can scraping clay from the bottom of the river in the months when the land is not frozen solid.
chinese_text: 特拉阿托普是由来自朱姆内河谷各领地的逃亡者和流民建立的定居点。它位于诺德人主要聚居区以东的遥远地带，坐落在草原边缘。与世隔绝的环境、严寒的冬季以及库赛特人频繁的袭击，使得很少有人胆敢质疑他们对这片土地的所有权。这里的居民在土地尚未封冻的月份里，靠从河底挖取黏土勉强维持生计。

english_text: Kjarved lies in the inland valleys of the western Nordvyg. Villagers tell stories of their famously foul-tempered and miserly ancestor Kjar, who came inland from the sea to escape a blood feud. For 60 years he mined salt from nearby deposits and accumulated a fabulous trove of wealth, all of which was a huge surprise to his dozens of children and grandchildren when they entered his modest farmhouse after his death to claim their inheritance.
chinese_text: 夏尔韦德位于诺德维格西部的内陆山谷。村民们讲述着他们那位出了名的脾气暴躁、吝啬的祖先夏尔的故事，他从海边逃到内陆，以躲避血仇。60年间，他从附近的盐矿中开采盐矿，积累了惊人的财富，当他去世后，他的数十个子孙进入他那间简陋的农舍继承遗产时，这些财富对他们来说是巨大的惊喜。

english_text: Grud was a thegn of the jarl of Hargard who established an outpost east of the Jumne River, which takes its name from the mysterious burial pits from some bygone people that lined its banks. The village named after him now herds sheep that range far out over the cold steppe to the east.
chinese_text: 格吕是雅尔阿加尔的一名乡绅战士，后者在朱姆内河东岸建立了一座哨站，其名称源于沿河两岸神秘的古老墓穴。这座以他名字命名的村庄如今牧放着羊群，羊群向东远至寒冷的草原深处。

english_text: Fimbulgard was named for the beach-side shacks used to dry herring, the staple food of its seafaring inhabitants. The wealth of the village, however, comes from the seasonal voyages along the northern coasts in search of whales and their oil.
chinese_text: 菲姆比加德以用于晾晒鲱鱼的海边棚屋而得名，这是长期在海上漂泊的船民们的主要食物。然而，这个村庄的财富来自于沿北部海岸寻找鲸鱼及其鲸油的季节性航行。

english_text: Zestea sits overlooking the Sethys River as it flows into the Perassic Sea. The conjoining of the waters makes for rich fishing grounds, for the shad and sardines who thrive in the brackish estuary waters as well as the tuna who come to eat them.
chinese_text: 泽斯特亚坐落在俯瞰塞堤斯河入海口的位置，这条河流最终注入珀拉斯海。咸淡水交汇的河口区域形成了富饶的渔场，既滋养了在微咸水域繁衍生息的西鲱和沙丁鱼，也吸引了以这些鱼群为食的金枪鱼前来觅食。

english_text: Hongard sits in the warm wooded lands near the meandering Trand River. This region, rich in wheat and once the heartland of the Empire, is now the center of the Vlandian kingdom.
chinese_text: 翁加尔坐落于蜿蜒的特朗河附近的温暖林地。这片盛产小麦的土地曾是帝国的腹地，如今却成了瓦兰迪亚王国的中心。

english_text: Urunjan sits near the eastern edge of the Devseg plateau, at the foot of the Sulan Dag mountains. Villagers raise cattle here that are bred to withstand both the hot summers and freezing winters.
chinese_text: 乌伦占位于速兰答各山脚下，靠近德夫赛格高原的东端。当地村民养牛以抵御寒冬与酷暑。

english_text: Tyal sits atop a high valley that climbs Mount Iltan, a craggy peak in eastern Calradia named for a god of the steppe peoples. This region has long stood aloof from the power struggles of the other Sturgian principalities. Its people are known as wanderers, traders, horse breeders and fur-trappers. The local aristocracy has occasionally exchanged princesses with the steppe tribes to the east to firm up a truce or a trade pact, and proudly includes the names of several great khans on their list of ancestors.
chinese_text: 蒂亚尔坐落于斯特吉亚东部边境的伊勒坦山西麓，该地区长期远离其他斯特吉亚公国的权力争斗。本地人多为流浪者、商贩、养马人和毛皮猎人。当地贵族偶尔会同东边的游牧部落互嫁公主，从而巩固休战条约或贸易协定，他们的先祖谱籍上赫然记载着几位伟大可汗的名字。

english_text: The village of Esme and its surrounding hamlets lie on the landward side of the Akkan Hills on the Devseg plateau, prime grazing lands for the horses of the Khuzaits and their confederates.
chinese_text: 埃斯梅村及其周围的村落位于阿克坎丘陵向陆侧的德夫赛格高原。这里是库赛特及其盟友的主要放牧地。

english_text: Vagnafit lies in a basin under the hills known as the Kjolfjallen, from their resemblance to the keel of a ship. The once boggy depression was drained under the orders of King Volbjorn, and the land distributed to some of the veterans who helped him gain power to grow wheat for Thronderlag and other towns.
chinese_text: 瓦格纳菲特位于山丘下的一个盆地，这些山丘因为形状酷似长船的龙骨，被人们称为龙骨山。这片曾经潮湿的低洼地是在沃尔比约恩国王的命令下被排干的，这片土地分配给了帮助他获得权力的一些退伍军人，种植的小麦用于供养特龙德拉格和其他城镇。

english_text: Gamardan sits at a key gap in the Epiric Hills, on the route between Charas and the imperial cities of the Aminys valley. The wines of this region are unusually sweet and strong, and valued throughout the Empire.
chinese_text: 伽玛耳丹位于埃皮尔山脉的一处重要隘口上，坐落在从沙拉斯通往阿米尼斯河谷诸帝国城市的商道上。此地出产的葡萄酒以甜度高、酒劲强而闻名，在整个帝国境内都极受珍视。

english_text: Ransam lies in the southern plains of the Devseg plateau. Villagers, who not long ago still lived a nomadic lifestyle, specialize in the rearing of horses.
chinese_text: 兰萨木位于德夫赛格高原南方的平原上。不久前还以游牧为生的村民们精于饲养马匹。

english_text: Svinstak lies inland of the Nordvyg coast, separated from the sea by a row of sharp-ridged hills. Stands of old-growth oak and other trees are still common here, providing the north with much of the timber for its ships.
chinese_text: 斯温斯塔克位于诺德维格峡湾的内陆区域，被一排尖峭的山脊丘陵与大海隔开。这里仍然常见老龄橡树和其他树木，为北方提供了大部分造船用材。

english_text: Hoeksten is named after a mysterious monolith found in the fields here by wandering herdsmen, subsequently ordered dug up by the local jarl and used in the foundations of Ykerslund Castle. He also ordered a village built on the auspicious site to settle refugees who had fled from the wars of Nord unification on the coast, and provided them with herds of cattle.
chinese_text: 赫克斯滕以这里被流浪牧民发现的神秘巨石命名，这块巨石后来被当地的雅尔下令挖出，成为了伊克斯伦德堡的地基。他还下令在这个吉祥的地点建立一个村庄，安置从北方统一战争海岸逃离的难民，并为他们提供牛群。

english_text: Dagby lies in the heights above Gretysfjord. Residents of the town harvest the great oaks on the slopes for the town's shipbuilding industry. On the summer solstice, village youths race by riding the logs as they slide down the hill, risking mangled limbs or broken backs for a chance at glory.
chinese_text: 达格比位于格雷蒂斯湾上方的山丘之中。镇上的居民在山坡上砍伐巨大的橡木，用于镇上的造船业。在夏至时，村里的年轻人骑在滑下山坡的原木上进行竞速，冒着四肢被压断或脊椎受伤的风险，只为争取那一线的荣耀。

english_text: The former Nord colony of Varcheg sits on a windswept bluff at the base of the Kachyar Peninsula in what was once Battanian land. The jarl who founded this outpost, hoping to trade with the interior, pledged himself in fealty to the Battanian High King Dernmachad, but then proceeded to dabble in Battanian politics. Annoyed, Dernmachad hired a Sturgian army to crush his unreliable new vassal. The Sturgians complied and routed the Nords, but then demanded the newly captured town as their payment. They called the town 'Varcheg,' a corruption of the Nordic term for 'oathsworn companion,' to mock both rivals whose quarreling had handed them their prize.
chinese_text: 曾经是诺德人殖民地的瓦尔切格位于风雨交加的海崖上，此地正是昔日巴旦尼亚领土的卡恰尔半岛深处。建立这个沿海前哨的雅尔希望与内陆进行贸易，于是向巴旦尼亚至高王戴恩玛查宣誓效忠，但随后却开始涉足巴旦尼亚政治。恼怒的戴恩玛查雇佣了斯特吉亚军队来击败他不可靠的新封臣。斯特吉亚人奉命击溃了诺德人，但随后要求把新夺得的城镇作为他们的报酬。他们将这个城镇称为“瓦尔切格”，这是诺德词“誓言之同伴”的变体，以嘲讽两个因争斗而将战利品拱手让给他们的敌人。

english_text: Ravikayr sits on rich volcanic soil in the interior of Beinland. Here, on the lower slopes of the dark Oskfjal mountain, much of the island's supply of grain is grown.
chinese_text: 拉维凯尔坐落在贝恩兰内陆的肥沃火山土壤上。在这里，黝黑的灰烬峰的下部山坡上，种植着供应给岛上大部分地方的谷物。

english_text: The legendary Queen Eshora, it is said, punished the jinn who were harassing her people by imprisoning them in one of the caves above Qasira, carving the mystical eight-pointed star into the rock to seal them in. She sentenced them to haul water from the depths of the earth, feeding the springs that gush forth from the rocks and which for centuries have irrigated the gardens of the Khisba, the small but rich coastal plain that adjoins the city.
chinese_text: 据说，传奇女王埃什乌拉狠狠地惩罚了那些骚扰她的子民并将其囚禁在加西拉上方山洞里的神灵，她在岩石上刻下了传说中的八芒星，将这些神灵封印于此。她判罚这些神灵去地底深处运水，用以滋养泉眼，使其不断地从岩缝中喷出活水。几个世纪以来，泉水一直灌溉着加西拉与周边村庄的椰枣园。

english_text: The village of Agilting on the eastern shores of the Byalic Sea began as a gathering point for local fishers and herders to resolve their claims and feuds. Like many such sites in the north, it has evolved into a village as local populations grew.
chinese_text: 阿格尔特村位于比亚里海的东侧海岸上，最初是当地渔民和牧民解决纠纷和争执的集会点。与北方许多类似地点一样，随着当地人口的增长，它逐渐发展成一个村庄。

english_text: Ortysia, named for the quails who inhabit the nearby coastal marshes, was the first Calradian colony on the shores of the Perassic Sea. In its early centuries, it fell under the authority of the Kannic city-state of Quyaz, but the Empire's expansion soon united the colony with its mother republic. For centuries, sailors coming from the pirate-infested islands of the Gulf of Charas gave thanks when they saw its towers looming through the haze of the western Perassic, signalling a return to safe imperial-patrolled waters.
chinese_text: 俄耳堤西亚，其名字来源于居住在周边海岸泽地里的鹌鹑，此地也是卡拉德人在珀拉斯海的第一块殖民地。在最初的几个世纪里，当地人被坎尼人的城邦古亚兹统治，但不久之后帝国的扩张将这块殖民地纳入了共和国的一部分。许多水手都来自于海盗蔓生的沙拉斯湾诸岛，几个世纪以来，这些水手都对此地高耸入云的灯塔心怀感激，其光束穿透了笼罩西珀拉斯海的迷雾，也预示着船只已经进入有帝国海巡队巡逻的安全水域。

english_text: Jalskveg, in the east of the Nordvyg north of Thronderlag, lies on one of the main routes from the coast to the more sparsely populated interior. The area is thick with ancient oak trees, which are harvested and dragged to the coast by oxen for use in shipbuilding.
chinese_text: 在诺德维格北部，靠近特龙德拉格东部的雅斯克韦格，是通往人烟稀少的内陆地区的主要枢纽之一。这片地区布满古老的橡树，这些树木被砍伐后，由牛拖运到海岸，用于造船。

english_text: Ortongard sits near the eastern edges of the Devseg plateau. The land is dry for most of the year but offers rich grazing in the spring. Founded by Darshi-speaking merchants, it made its wealth buying horses, sheep and cattle from the surrounding herding villages and sending them west to the markets of the Empire in huge drives, accompanied by guards to ward off raiders from the steppes. Neither its walls nor its mercenary armies could withstand the coming of Khan Urkhun, however, who granted it to the Khergit clan in recognition of their valor.
chinese_text: 奥通加德坐落于德夫赛格高原的东部边缘。这片土地常年干旱，但在春天十分适合放牧。此城由讲达西语的商人建立，商人们从周边的牧民村庄购置马匹、绵羊、牛，并在防备草原掠袭队的护卫陪同下，将其成群结队地赶到西边的帝国市场贩卖，以此获取大量财富。然而，无论是城墙还是雇佣军都没能抵挡住兀儿浑汗的大军，后者将此城授予库吉特部族，以表彰他们的英勇作战。

english_text: Sirindac lies beneath the high ridges of the Ebor peninsula, somewhat sheltered from the bitter winds blowing out of the northwest. It was settled by prospectors hunting for silver in the mountain streams, but that has mostly been exhausted and the region now mostly exports clay for local potters.
chinese_text: 西岚达克坐落于埃博半岛的高山脚下，稍微阻挡了自西北方刮来的刺骨寒风。这里最初是淘银者在山涧溪流中寻觅银矿的地方，但银矿资源大多已枯竭，现在该地区主要出口粘土供当地陶工使用。

english_text: Razih is said to be the base from which Kannic explorers set forth to colonize the shores of the Perassic Sea in the centuries before the coming of the Empire, the prows of their ships decorated with the intertwined vine leaves of the Kannic goddess of wealth, wine, love and war. Today, the Kannic tongue has been replaced by Nahasawi dialects and their religion is all but forgotten, but the symbol lives on, said to protect those who risk all for the sake of gain or glory.
chinese_text: 据说，早在帝国人来到这片大陆的几个世纪以前，拉齐赫就成为了坎族探险家们殖民珀拉斯海岸的基地。他们的船首装饰着葡萄藤编织而成的神像，象征财富、葡萄酒、爱与战争。如今，坎族口音已经彻底被纳哈撒语替代，他们的宗教也被彻底遗忘，但他们的标志却保留了下来，依旧诉说着那些甘愿冒一切风险以获得荣耀的勇敢冒险家的故事。

english_text: Drapand sits near the tip of Cape Fal, a promontory just south of the mouth of the Trand River. The foremost seafaring village on this coast, it gives its name to the bay to its north. The villagers venture out far into the seas to hunt right and blackfish whales, and sometimes range as far north as Beinland chasing bowheads and narwhals.
chinese_text: 德拉邦位于特朗河口正南方的法尔海角角尖处。它是这片海岸最重要的航海村落，其名字也赋予了其北部海湾。村民们冒险深入远海捕猎露脊鲸和黑鲸，有时甚至北上远至贝恩兰地区追逐弓头鲸和独角鲸。

english_text: Zeonica sits by the seaside at the base of the Iltaric Hills, a land of wine, grain and horses. It was named for the Lady Zeona, one of the few women to rule the Empire - admittedly as regent for her son rather than Empress Regnant. It is known for the Zeonic Wind, a gale that blows northward across the Perassic Sea every summer carrying the burning heat of the Nahasa desert to the imperial south. In other seasons the weather here is mild, a weather pattern that has provided many a poet with a metaphor for the transience of passion.
chinese_text: 泽翁尼卡位于滨海的伊勒塔尔丘陵之上，这是一片盛产美酒、谷物与骏马的土地。它的名字来源于泽翁娜女士，少数几位统治过帝国的女性之一——名义上依旧作为她儿子的摄政，而非帝国的女皇。此地也因泽翁娜之风而闻名，这是一股夏季朝北吹的季风，将纳哈撒沙漠的炎热带过珀拉斯海，来到帝国的南方。该地其他季节的天气都十分温和，这样的气候也孕育了无数隐喻激情稍纵即逝的诗歌。

english_text: Mjallagdal sits in a thickly wooded valley inland from Gretysfjord. Trees in these woods are often marked with the glyph of an horned archer carved into the bark, the work of a villager invoking the help of the god Ulthin in their hunt for marten, squirrel and other fur-bearing animals.
chinese_text: 姆亚拉格达坐落在格雷蒂斯湾内陆部分一处林木茂密的山谷中。这里的树木树皮上常刻有带角弓箭手的符文，这是村民为祈求狩猎之神厄尔辛庇佑他们猎取貂、松鼠等毛皮动物而刻下的印记。

english_text: Thronderlag was the gathering place of the Throndar, the legendary progenitors of the Nordic realm. Here, overlooking the sea, the clans would assemble on the cold spring equinox to resolve their disputes, choose a target for summertime raiding, and elect a warleader. Today the Nord king takes counsel mainly with a select group of his jarls in his hall, and such great assemblies are no longer held, but Thonderlag remains the symbolic center of the Nordvyg.
chinese_text: 特龙德拉格曾是传说中的诺德国先祖特龙德拉人的集会之地。在这处俯瞰大海的高地上，各部族每逢寒春分日便会聚集于此——调解争端、选定夏季劫掠目标、推选战争首领。如今，诺德的国王们主要在其厅堂内与获选的雅尔们商议国事，此类盛大集会已不复举行，但特龙德拉格仍是诺德维格象征性的中心之地。

english_text: Ruvenbrek sits in the far northeast of the lands settled by the Nords. Rich deposits of iron ore in the soil here, their wealth visible from rust-brown streaks on hillsides or in the waters of bogs, have drawn migrants to this otherwise remote and forbidding region.
chinese_text: 吕文布雷克坐落在诺德人定居区域的最东北处。这里土壤中富含铁矿石，其财富从山坡上的锈褐色条纹或沼泽水中可见，吸引了移民来到这个偏远而艰苦的地区。

english_text: Ykerslund is one of the northernmost districts of the Nordic kingdom. Its first inhabitants settled around a grove sacred to a wilderness goddess, and every year sacrifice in the hope of receiving her blessing to hunt in nearby woods.
chinese_text: 伊克斯伦德是诺德王国最北部的地区之一。最初的居民定居在一片供奉荒野女神的圣林周围，每年举行祭祀，祈求获得她的恩准在附近森林中狩猎。

english_text: Oristocorys lies on a peninsula west of the Bay of Ortysia. The village sits high on a slope to avoid both mosquitos from coastal marshes and raiding corsairs from the south, but the villagers make their way each morning to the sheltered covers where they keep their boats and set out to catch tuna, swordfish and other large species that migrate through the bay.
chinese_text: 俄里斯托科律斯位于俄耳堤西亚湾西边的半岛上。村庄高踞山坡之上，既为远离沿海沼泽的蚊虫侵扰，也为躲避南方海盗的劫掠。村民们每日清晨都会前往隐蔽的海湾，那里停泊着他们的渔船。他们出海捕捞金枪鱼、旗鱼等洄游通过海湾的大型鱼类。

english_text: Ocs Hall is one of the few towns in the Vlandian kingdom that was founded after the seizure of the land from the Empire. This valley was once an isolated holdout of Battanians, centered on the Llyn Modris, a marshy pool said to be the court of a watery spirit-queen to whom the peoples of the region made offerings. It was conquered however by the Vlandian warlord Oca, who drained the pool for farmland and built his great hall on the heights above. The Battanian tribes were driven inland, over the Rhennod, and took their legends with them.
chinese_text: 奥克斯·霍尔是少数几座瓦兰迪亚王国从帝国手中夺取这片土地之后建立起来的城镇。这片山谷曾一度是一块巴旦尼亚人的飞地，以莫德里斯湖为中心——这座湖泊位于火山口，传说是一道巨人的足印。这里后来被瓦兰迪亚的一位军阀奥克征服，附近的奥克斯湖也是以他的名字命名。该地的巴旦尼亚部落带着他们的传说一起被赶回到了内陆。

english_text: Paravenos was the second major colony founded by Calradios the Great, and it soon succeeded Charasea as the capital of the Calradians. Eventually, the Empire's center of gravity moved east, but Paravenos retained its primacy as the economic center of the West. When Osric Iron-Arm the Vlandian invaded, he recognized Paravenos would be far more valuable as a seat of power than as simply as a source of loot,  and negotiated its surrender with local senators. It passed to a cadet branch of Osric's line, the dey Tihr clan, and is today known as Pravend.
chinese_text: 巴拉维诺斯是由卡拉狄乌斯大帝建立的第二座重要的殖民地，并在随后迅速取代沙拉斯，成为了卡拉德人的首都。最终，帝国的统治重心东移，但巴拉维诺斯依旧是西部的经济重镇。当瓦兰迪亚人“铁壁”奥斯里克入侵时，他意识到巴拉维诺斯作为权力的宝座，比作为掠夺的财源更有价值，于是同当地的元老协商让该城投降。此地传承到了奥斯里克的旁支，戴·提尔家族手中，如今人们称其为帕拉汶德。

english_text: Gretysfjord is perhaps the oldest walled town in the Nordvyg, yet there are greybeards here who claim their grandsires were among the first to settle here permanently. At first it was but a seasonal market by the shore, drawing in traders from across the seas, until a local chief built walls and a great hall and began calling himself jarl. It is still the most frequented port on the Nordvyg, a welcome refuge to sailors from the unpredictable and cold northern seas.
chinese_text: 格雷蒂斯湾或许是诺德维格最古老的竖墙城镇，现今当地仍有白发老者坚称自己的祖父辈是最早在此永久定居的先民。这里最初不过是海岸边一处季节性集市，吸引着跨海而来的商旅，直到某位当地酋长筑起围墙、建起大礼堂，并自封为雅尔领主。时至今日，这里仍是诺德维格最繁忙的港口，为航行于变幻莫测的北方寒海中的水手们提供温暖的庇护所。

english_text: Mot lies in the Neurval, a valley that runs between the Biscan and Epiric hills, known for the blaze of poppies that cover its slopes in the spring. The warm lands of the Vlandian south are well-suited to the growing of olives.
chinese_text: 莫特坐落于穿过比斯坎山脉与埃皮尔山脉的纳尔谷，以春季山坡上盛开的艳丽虞美人花海而闻名。这片瓦兰迪亚南部的温暖土地非常适合种植橄榄。

english_text: The village of Lagshofn was founded by the explorer and trade Lag, who cast his seat-pillars into the sea and followed them to this spot. His intrepid descendants sail from here into the straits between Hvalvik and Vlandia, where they hunt right whales, blackfish and other quarry on their migration routes between the Byalic Sea and the northern ocean.
chinese_text: 拉葛斯霍芬村由探险家兼商人拉格所建，他将座椅支柱投入海中，并追随它们来到此地。他勇敢的后裔们从这里启航，驶入瓦尔维克与瓦兰迪亚之间的海峡，在比亚里海与北部海洋之间的洄游路线上捕猎露脊鲸、黑鲸及其他猎物。

english_text: Troverag is a mining colony in the bleak hills overlooking the Byalic Sea. The dour inhabitants are known for laboring long into the night, and the glow of their forges can be seen far from shore.
chinese_text: 特罗维拉格是一个位于比亚里海的海岸边荒凉山丘上的矿业殖民地。这里的居民性格严肃，以长夜劳作闻名，他们锻造的火光可以从海岸远处看到。

english_text: Omor sits on the eastern shores of Lake Laconis. Long before the Sturgians formed themselves into a principality it was a holy site for the forest tribes, who worshipped their gods and ancestors in the sacred oak trees of the nearby woods. Today, it is an emporium for fur trappers and woodsmen, and the primeval peace of the forests is drowned out by the sounds of bartering, saws, and the unloading of ships at the lake.
chinese_text: 奥莫尔位于拉科尼斯湖的东岸。早在斯特吉亚成为大公国之前，这里就已成为森林部落民的一处圣地，他们在树林里的橡树旁膜拜神明和先祖。如今，此地是毛皮猎人和樵夫的集市，他们在东面的伊卡拉荒原上徘徊。森林里原始的静谧也被嘈杂的叫卖声、锯木声以及湖面上船只的卸货声所打破。

english_text: Khimli sits in a basin in the Devseg plateau. Though this land is dry most of the year, it experiences winter snowfalls and muddy springs. Fine clay can be collected from the pools left by the snowmelt and the rains.
chinese_text: 希木利位于德夫赛格高原的一块盆地内。虽然这片土地几乎终年干旱，但仍有着冬季降雪和泥泞的春季。在化雪和下雨留下的水坑处能采集到优质的黏土。

english_text: Faergap lies on the passage through the bleak hills that divide the eastern coasts of the Byalic Sea from the Jumne valley. As the pass crests, and the rich lands of the Jumne come into view, a traveller can read runic inscriptions carved on boulders by Nordic migrants, giving thanks to the gods for their safe journey.
chinese_text: 法尔加普坐落于荒凉山峦间的隘口，这条通道将比亚里海东岸与朱姆内谷地分隔开来。当旅人翻越山口、富饶的朱姆内大地映入眼帘时，可以看到诺德移民刻在巨石上的如尼铭文，这些文字向诸神感恩他们平安抵达的旅程。

english_text: Sibir was founded on the seaward slopes of the Chertyg Mountains by Nordic traders, who wished a base to buy furs from the local Vakken-speaking foresters. As the Sturgian tribes became principalities, and elected chieftains evolved into boyars who demanded taxes and labor as their due, this region became a magnet for Sturgians who had little taste for deference. Today, the ambitious Isyaroving family governs this region, but they must always balance their hunger for wealth and men to fight their wars with their subjects' reluctance to provide it.
chinese_text: 诺德的商人们在车尔特格山脉的一处幽谷中建立了西比尔，他们希望以此为基地和当地操瓦肯语的森民们进行毛皮贸易。当斯特吉亚诸部落转变为公国，部落酋长被选为波耶后，他们开始将征税和徭役视为应得之物，所以对于那些不爱受管制的斯特吉亚人来说，这块土地变得极富吸引力。如今，野心勃勃的伊夏罗夫家族统治着这片地区，不过他们必须小心斟酌自己对财富的渴望，否则他们的士兵就要面对不愿交钱并揭竿而起的臣民。

english_text: Arromanc lies in the Neurval, a valley that runs between the Biscan and Epiric hills. The warm lands of the Vlandian south, where the air smells of sage, lavender and thyme, are well-suited to the growing of olives.
chinese_text: 阿罗曼克坐落于穿过比斯坎山脉与埃皮尔山脉的纳尔谷。瓦兰迪亚南部温暖的土地上，空气中弥漫着鼠尾草、薰衣草和百里香的芬芳，这里非常适合种植橄榄树。

english_text: Vorfjall lies on the hills east of the Jumne, known for the bloom of purple lupin that fill the highland meadows in the late spring. The village sustains itself mining salt from deposits, some in vibrant streaks of color, that can be found in the nearby hills.
chinese_text: 沃夫亚尔位于朱姆内河东部的山丘上，以其在晚春时节覆盖高地草原的紫色羽扇豆花而闻名。这个村庄通过开采附近山丘中蕴藏的盐矿得以维持生计，其中有些盐矿呈现出鲜艳的彩色条纹。

english_text: Elvania overlooks the estuary of the Aminys River. Hot southern afternoons and sea-cooled mornings make this good country for wine grapes.
chinese_text: 厄尔凡尼亚俯瞰着阿米尼斯河的入海口。炎热的南方午后与海风清凉的清晨，使这里成为种植酿酒葡萄的理想之地。

english_text: Car Banseth sits on the bay that the Battanians used to call Muir Mon. The seafaring clans of this coast claim that the ancestors of the Battanians came across these waters to settle their lands. They say that those who keep faith will one day witness from this high point the ships of the vanished High King Mon, who shall return to deliver his people from their enemies. But today, they call it the Muir Gal, the foreigner's sea, as one is far more likely to see the sails of Nordic adventurers and mercenaries, coming to join Sturgians, Vlandians and others in their relentless push into Battanian land.
chinese_text: 卡·班塞斯位于艾塔·德鲁因的峭壁之上。如果有人在明朗的晴天向北望去，目光越过那片曾经属于巴旦尼亚，现在却被瓦兰迪亚人和斯特吉亚人占领的土地，就能看到瓦尔切格湾的粼粼波光。据说，心怀信念之人会在某一天从这里看到已逝至高王蒙的船队，他将重返人间，拯救自己的子民于水火之中。但如今，在这更可能看到的是诺德的冒险者和雇佣兵，他们来这的目的是帮助外国人不断蚕食巴旦尼亚的土地。

english_text: Midskag is named after the cape that lies roughly halfway from the western end of the Nordvyg to the capital of Thronderlag. The villagers of the region near Midskag make their living from the sea, harvesting cod and ice-char from nearby banks.
chinese_text: 米兹卡格得名于一处海角，该海角大致位于诺德维格西端至特龙德拉格首府的中间位置。米兹卡格附近地区的村民以捕捞附近海域的鳕鱼和冰鱼为生。

english_text: Phycaon sits at the head of the Sethys valley, one of the main grain-producing regions of the central Empire. Once the largest of the Palaic cities, its leaders led a league of the tribes against imperial encroachment into the region. But when the Empire's victory looked inevitable, they made their peace. The population, now thoroughly Calradicized, have a reputation for being serious, respectable and trade-minded, dependable if a bit humorless.
chinese_text: 费卡翁位于塞堤斯山谷的起始处，这里是帝国中部重要的谷物生产中心。费卡翁曾是最大的帕拉城市，其统治者团结了各部落以抵抗帝国对该地区的入侵。然而当帝国的胜利已成必然之时，他们选择了求和。如今当地人已彻底卡拉德化，人们都说这里的人严肃、受人尊敬、有经商头脑、可靠，就是没什么幽默感。

english_text: Kargrev was once Car Gryff, the ringfort of the Battanian chief Gryff, but was conquered by the Sturgians two generations ago. Recently, the most intrepid of the villagers have joined Nords and others who go every summer to the far north, to Beinland and beyond, in search of walrus ivory.
chinese_text: 卡格雷夫曾经叫作卡尔·格莱夫——巴旦尼亚酋长格莱夫的环形堡垒，但两代人之前此地被斯特吉亚人征服。近来，最大胆的村民加入了诺德人等群体的行列，每年夏季前往极北之地——贝恩兰及更远区域，以猎取海象象牙。

english_text: Sahel sits on the edge of the Bay of Qasira, beneath the red sandstone Jabal Ashabi mountains. This ridge catches rainclouds coming off the Bahr al-Yeshm sea and are brushed by monsoons from the southeast, allowing cistern-watered fields of flax.
chinese_text: 萨赫勒位于阿塞莱领土的边陲，坐落在低矮的阿沙卜山脉上。山脉留住了来自耶什姆海的雨云，和自东南方向吹来的季风，使得当地的贮水农田可种植栗子和小麦。

english_text: Asmait lies in a nook of the red sandstone Jabal Ashabi mountains, bordered to the south by the deep desert. Villagers trap floods running down the hills during rare rainstorms, using the water to grow date palms and other crops.
chinese_text: 阿斯麦特位于阿沙卜山脉的角落，南边毗邻沙漠深处。村民们会在罕见的暴雨天截住山上的洪流，利用这些水种植椰枣树及其他作物。

english_text: Ain Baliq is clustered around a well between the mesas of the Jarjara Escarpmen. The surrounding lands, though dry, produce enough grass in the spring to allow the breeding of horses.
chinese_text: 艾因·巴力克的村民围绕着一口开阔山谷内的水井繁衍生息，这道山谷将杰尔贾赖峭壁从塔玛尔山的西面分割开来。其周围的土地尽管干旱，但在春季仍可长出足以繁育马匹的牧草。

english_text: Deir Hawa sits perched on the slopes of a mesa in the Jarjara Escarpment. This windswept bluff was once a refuge for religious ascetics, but their isolation came to an abrupt end when one of the curious pilgrims who came to visit them spotted the gleam of silver in the surrounding rocks. Prospectors have long exhausted the richest veins, but the villagers who live here today practice a number of close-guarded techniques to extract the precious metal from the ores that remain.
chinese_text: 代尔·哈瓦坐落于阿塞莱人所说的耶什姆海的当风南岸。村民们依靠在附近干燥的山丘上开采露天银矿维持生计。尽管几个世纪的开采早已耗尽了最丰富的矿脉，但村民们仍采用一些秘而不宣的技术，从矿石中提取贵金属。

english_text: Qidnar sits on the landward side of the Jarjara Escarpment, looking down onto the deep desert of the central Nahasa. Here, the fierce rains that come once every few years fall onto rocky hills replete with clefts and crevaces, and can be diverted with channels into peaceful palm-gardens.
chinese_text: 吉德纳尔坐落于达玛尔河的河漫滩，该地穿过杰尔贾赖峭壁，是阿塞莱人口最稠密的地方。当地农民依靠河水每年周期性泛滥带来的淤泥种植椰枣。

english_text: Jamayeh lies on the eastern end of the Jabal Minshar, a sharp sandstone ridge that runs parallel to the coast. Here the villagers grow olive trees overlooking the nearby Bay of Qasira.
chinese_text: 贾迈耶位于阿塞莱人所说的“拜赫尔·耶什姆”，即“翡翠之海”的南岸。当地虽然雨季短暂，但气候很适合橄榄树生长。

english_text: Shibal Zumr lies where the Nahr al-Kals, the river of lime, comes down from the coastal hills to meet the Tiagys. Here the waters are pure and the soil is fertile, and grain is grown. But a short distance to the east, the land becomes barren and alkaline, and only the hardiest crops survive.
chinese_text: 希巴勒·祖姆尔位于“奈赫尔·凯勒斯”，即石灰河之畔。此处水清土沃，可种植谷物。但再往南不远，就是贫瘠的盐碱地，只能种些特别好养活的庄稼。

english_text: Uqba sits on the coastal plain of the Perassic Sea, which the Aserai call the Bahr al-Yeshm. Villagers trap rainwater and runoff from the hills to water their fields and their gardens of date-palms.
chinese_text: 但再次假设你是执政官加里俄斯，正谋划称帝。你需要与苏丹缔结条约，宜早不宜迟。而苏丹的朝廷里满是心怀不甘的商人。因此，你宣布了一份将被流放的人员名单，都是些才智胆识兼备之人，闻名于整个珀拉斯海。

english_text: Bunqaz sits at the mouth of the wadi that divides the Jarjara Escarpment from the granite outcrop of the Jabal Tamar. Villagers sink wells here to tap the wadi's groundwater, using it to irrigate their olive groves.
chinese_text: 本盖兹坐落于分割杰尔贾赖峭壁与塔玛尔山的大旱谷的入口处。村民们通过打井来获取旱谷的地下水，用来灌溉橄榄林。

english_text: Tamnuh lies near the southern end of the Jabal al-Kals, the bitter hills. The nearby castle guards the coastal land route between the Empire and the Aserai lands, a highway used by caravans and armies for thousands of years.
chinese_text: 坦姆努坐落于珀拉斯海被沙嘴分割出的大潟湖边。村民们刮取浅水区的黏土，卖给当地的陶工。

english_text: The oasis-village of Barihal sits in a wadi between the mesas of the Jarjara Escarpment and the granite outcrop of the Jabal Tamar. The land is best known for the horses that are grazed on the desert's short-lived but rich spring grasses.
chinese_text: 巴里哈勒绿洲村位于杰尔贾赖峭壁台地中的旱谷边。当地最出名的是用短命而肥美的春草饲养的马匹。

english_text: Ab Comer sits on the Etircomb, the steep valley which climbs from the Vlandian coastal plain to the Uchalion plateau, cut by the small creeks feeding the Trand River. The tribes of this region grow grapes on the hillsides, used to make a white wine popular with the imperial and Vlandian aristocracies.
chinese_text: 阿布·科梅尔坐落于穿过乌卡利翁高原的特朗河上游的陡峭处。当地各部落会在山坡上种植葡萄，用以酿造一种深受帝国与瓦兰迪亚贵族欢迎的白葡萄酒。

english_text: Llanoc Hen sits at the foot of the Cafalcombe that climbs from the western imperial lands to the Uchalion massif. Oak and other trees grow thick in the valley, providing nuts and thick roots to feed the local hogs.
chinese_text: 拉诺克·亨位于乌卡利翁地块的高山山脊处。村民们都是熟练的养猪户，他们下山后有两条路，一条向西通往瓦兰迪亚，另一条向东通往帝国。

english_text: Cantrec sits in the rocky Cafalcombe that climbs up from the imperial lands into the plateau of the Uchalion. The lands is not especially fertile here, but pigs thrive in the bush and shrubland of the heights.
chinese_text: 坎特雷克坐落于帝国领土通往乌喀利昂高原处多岩的巴拉索格峡谷之中。当地土壤并不十分肥沃，但高处的灌木林地很适合养猪。

english_text: Druimmor sits at one of the highest points on the Uchalion massif, the mountain fastness at the heart of the Battanian realm. Miners here have found silver in clefts in the hillsides.
chinese_text: 德鲁伊莫尔坐落于摩康谷——一道分割乌卡利翁高原与埃博半岛的裂谷之中。矿工在当地的山边裂缝处发现了银矿。

english_text: Pendraic sits on a high outcrop beneath the lofty Ben Callach, said to have been a stone dropped by the divine crone Callach as she swept over the Uchalion bringing winter storms from the north. To the west it overlooks the Llyn Tywal lake, and to its south a steep pass that is traditionally one of the main routes between the Battanian heartland on the Uchalion massif and the Empire. The villagers raise hogs here on acorns which grow from oak trees on the heights.
chinese_text: 潘德拉克坐落在乌卡利翁北部的陡坡上，面对着瓦尔切格湾。该地频繁受到冷风与瓦兰迪亚、巴旦尼亚、斯特吉亚劫掠队的侵袭，小规模战斗时有发生。养猪的村民们一听到警戒号角声，就把畜群赶进山中的藏身处。

english_text: Rhemtoil lies beneath a cleft in the eastern escarpment of the Uchalion plateau. A waterfall cascades down the cliffside here to form River Miron, which the Battanians call the Myr. This is among the most fertile of the Battanian lands, and produces a fine crop of wheat.
chinese_text: 雷姆托伊尔位于乌卡利翁高原东部悬崖的裂隙下，靠近巴旦尼亚人称为“米尔”的弥戎河的源头。这里是巴旦尼亚土壤最肥沃的地方，小麦收成很好。

english_text: Claig Ban sits nestled in a small hollow amid the heights of the Uchalion massif. The clays of this region are much prized for their vivid red hues.
chinese_text: 克莱格·班坐落于乌卡利翁地块的一堵悬崖下。村民们从旁边的米尔河中收集黏土，卖给巴旦尼亚各城镇的陶工。

english_text: Flintolg sits on the so-called Stairs of Morac, a series of trails that run up the more accessible slopes of the Ailta Druin escarpment. The soil is poor but the woods grow thick here, making this the source of much of the timber used in the Battanian lands.
chinese_text: 弗林托格坐落于乌卡利翁地块东部的高山山顶处。当地土壤贫瘠，但树木生得粗壮，使得这里成为巴旦尼亚的木材主要产地。

english_text: Glintor sits on a bluff towards the bottom of the Ailtra Druin cliffs, looking down upon the sea that the Battanians call the Muir Gal. Horses are raised on patches of rich pastureland in the glens between the crags, much prized by both raiders and traders from the Sturgian across the water.
chinese_text: 格林托尔俯瞰着湍急的费尔河，来自泰瓦尔湖的水流由此汇入瓦尔切格湾。当地草甸养出的马匹备受北方斯特吉亚强盗与商贩们的喜爱。

english_text: Aster perches amid the crags of the Ailtra Druin, between the heights of the Uchalion and the sea. The people of this region have the reputation of being more focused on trade than warfare, and tribal elders have encouraged the planting of vineyards to produce a particularly strong vintage of wine.
chinese_text: 阿斯特坐落于乌卡利翁东北部山丘和格兰尼斯山间的浅谷中。当地人比起打仗更关注贸易，部落长老们鼓励大家种植葡萄以酿造出特别醇厚的葡萄酒。

english_text: Uthelaim sits on the eastern frontiers of the Battanian lands on a ridge overlooking a tributary of the Myr, just before it rushes down the slope towards Lake Laconis, and the Empire. The people of these parts are foresters, felling the oak, yew and pine of the woods for sale to builders and shipwrights.
chinese_text: 乌瑟莱姆位于巴旦尼亚东部边境的一座山脊上，俯瞰着米尔河的一条支流。当地人是林农，他们采伐橡树、紫杉和松树，并将木材卖给建筑工和造船工。

english_text: Lochana is named for a castle that guards the Carcasos river. Along with Epinosa, its twin on the opposite bank, it forms the centuries-old border defense of this far-flung corner of empire against raiders from the north. The nearby sea tempers the cold of the northern winters here, allowing the cultivation of mulberry bushes for silk.
chinese_text: 罗卡那位于拉科尼斯湖的东岸。拉科尼斯湖缓和了北方冬季的寒冷，为种植桑树、产蚕丝提供了条件。

english_text: Rhesos sits amid the jumbled ridges of the Lesser Dryatic Mountains. Highland cattle thrive on the grasses of the heights.
chinese_text: 雷索斯位于德律亚山脉的一片高原上。高原牛靠着这里的高地牧草茁壮成长。

english_text: Gaos sits in a broad valley in the Myzead, the rugged highlands in the east of the Empire. Nomadic herders once occupied this land, and the village's name is taken from their word for cattle.
chinese_text: 伽俄斯位于帝国东边的丘陵地——密泽亚德的宽阔山谷中。游牧民族曾占据此地，村庄就得名于他们语言中“牛”的叫法。

english_text: Atrion lies by the delta of the Nevys, a cold, slow-moving river that drains into Lake Laconis. The land here was mostly marsh until a well-financed consortium of imperial gentry built dykes to reclaim it. Today they cultivate mulberry bushes, used to produce silk.
chinese_text: 阿特里翁坐落于涅维斯谷中，冰冷的缓流由此汇入拉科尼斯湖。这里的土地适合种植桑树，用于生产蚕丝。

english_text: Epinosa sits on a tongue of land surrounded by rivers, the names of which reflect the long history of trade and conflict in this vital crossroads. The northern branch is known as the Caracasos, a name which derives from the Sturgian Karakaz, which itself derives from a Khuzait language. The Nords know it as the Jumne, a word derived from the Sturgian word for barrow. The southern branch is known to all the peoples of this region as the Davuna. The villagers here raise cattle on the thick grass of the riverside marches.
chinese_text: 厄毗诺萨位于帝国的极北之地，刚好在伊勒坦运输线的冰川湖南岸，拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间的船只川流不息。该地区人口相对稀少，但葱郁的草甸上放养着大群的牛。

english_text: Pons was named for a bridge across the Caracasos River, though that was washed out generations ago in a flood and replaced by other crossings both upstream and downstream. The locals mine deposits of salt from nearby hills.
chinese_text: 庞斯是帝国最北端的定居点之一。该地因位于伊勒坦运输线的“交叉口”而得名，一系列冰川湖构成的网络令船只得以通行于拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间。当地人在附近的山丘上开采盐矿。

english_text: Syratos sits at the the base of Mount Tarnea, west of Lake Tanaesis. Flax grows well here, in the cold damp valley floor.
chinese_text: 叙拉托斯坐落于塔奈西斯湖北岸的一处峭壁之上。在这寒冷潮湿的谷底，亚麻生长得很好。

english_text: Tememos lies where the Plain of Ichala rises to meet the highlands of the Myzead. Horses graze on the mountain slopes in the summers and are taken to the valley floor when grasses sproud there after the winter rains.
chinese_text: 特美摩斯坐落于塔奈西斯湖北端树木繁茂的丘陵地。当地许多村民都是林农，他们采伐橡树、山毛榉和松树并销往湖边的城镇。

english_text: Mecalovea sits on a rocky shelf of the Dryatic Mountains, surrounded on three sides by the Miron River and its tributary streams. This site affords it some protection from the raiders and brigands who plague this frontier region. The fast-flowing water has cut through the rock to expose rich seams of iron ore.
chinese_text: 墨卡罗维亚俯瞰着伽尔喀斯大瀑布，这座瀑布由一系列湍急的水流构成，并最终同弥戎河一起汇入拉科尼斯湖。村庄座落于一道峭壁之上，以期在这边疆之地免受强盗匪帮的侵扰。飞流直下的瀑布拍过峭壁，将许多矿石暴露出来，村民就以此为生。

english_text: Agalmon sits in a valley in the Dryatic Mountains. The soil here is rich for a highland region, and the villagers have learned how to use terracing and other techniques to coax grain out of the mountain soil.
chinese_text: 阿加尔蒙紧挨着两条细小而湍急的北方河流——伽尔喀斯河和弥戎河的汇流处。这座多林村庄的居民世代与相邻的斯特吉亚人通婚，原本往来颇为友好，然而战争的爆发令双方关系趋于紧张。

english_text: Odrysa lies near the Aserai frontier at the Calsean Gates, where the hills come down almost to the sea. The boulders here are covered with thousands of years of graffiti, in Calradic, in Nahasawi, Darshi, Kannic and a dozen other languages, from conquerors' triumphant declarations to their soldiers' homesick complaints. Though this area is dry, cedars and other trees grow in gorges in the hills, sustaining a small lumber industry.
chinese_text: 俄德律萨坐落于帝国遥远的东部边境，蒂亚具斯河对岸就是如今库赛特汗国的领土。尽管当地气候干旱，但橡树等树木仍生长于蒂亚具斯峡谷和其他山谷的角落，为小规模的木材业提供原料。

english_text: Corenia is one of the farthest flung villages of the Empire to speak the Calradic tongue. It lies in the north of the Tanaetic Plain, on the shores of Lake Tanaesis. Villagers grow grain here, keeping watch for raiders from across the frontiers.
chinese_text: 科雷尼亚是帝国境内最偏远的村庄之一，这里的人还说着卡拉德语。它位于塔奈西斯湖东南方的平原上，阿克坎丘陵附近。过了那座山，人们就只说达西语和草原民族的语言了。当地村民种植谷物，随时提防着犯边的掠袭者。

english_text: Metachia lies on the southern shores of Lake Tanaesis, where the coastal plain begins to climb towards the ridges of the Myzead. This imperial colony, established in more peaceful times, is a center for mulberry bushes used in silk production.
chinese_text: 墨塔基亚坐落于塔奈西斯湖南岸越过蒂亚具斯河的边境地带上。这个帝国殖民地建于和平时期，是丝织业所需的桑树种植中心。

english_text: Melion sits in a narrow valley near the center of the Myzead, the rugged highlands in the east of the Empire. Villagers here cultivate mulberry bushes. The leaves are harvested and fed to silkworks, producing thread much valued by both refined imperial nobles for their courtwear and hard-riding nomads and frontiersmen, who wear it beneath their armor as an extra layer of protection against arrows.
chinese_text: 墨利翁在密泽亚德——帝国东部崎岖高原的中央附近的一道狭窄山谷里。当地村民种植桑树，收获的树叶喂给蚕，产出的丝线同时受到衣着朝服的优雅帝国贵族与戎马倥偬的牧民边民的珍爱。后者将丝绸衣物穿在铠甲下，作为对箭矢的一层额外防护。

english_text: Sagolina sits at the foot of a narrow valley at the southern end of the Myzead, the rugged highlands of eastern Calradia. Villagers mine salt from deposits in the hills.
chinese_text: 萨戈利那坐落于密泽亚德——卡拉迪亚东部崎岖高原的一道狭窄山谷底。附近山上开采的银矿解释了帝国为何在过去的几世纪内耗费人力物力对此地加以征服与守卫。

english_text: Lavenia sits on the northeastern shores of the Perassic. The people of this region sustain themselves by fishing, but also by serving on merchant vessels that haul cargos across the great inland sea, the imperial fleets that protect them, or the corsairs that prey on them.
chinese_text: 拉文尼亚是珀拉斯海东北岸的一座渔村。附近的城堡守卫着通往阿塞莱领土的关口要道，这些由湖泊和咸水湖构成的交通网络被称为卡勒萨。

english_text: Ethemisa lies in a low valley in the Thymian Hills. This region was once barren and mostly deserted, save for the hermits and visionaries who made their homes in its limestone caves. Ethemisa was home to some of the first permanent migrants, who tapped wells on the valley floor to irrigate their fields. According to legend, they demanded that one of the holy recluses here serve as their leader and guide them to virtue. At first he refused, but Heaven sent a flock of goats to follow him everywhere, disturbing his solitude, until he at least repented.
chinese_text: 厄忒弥萨坐落于阿塞莱人口中的“奈赫尔·凯勒斯”，即苦河之畔，帝国居民称之为卡勒萨。此处的河流刚从海边山上流下，尚未到达东南方的盐碱平原。附近土地的小麦收成很好。

english_text: Morenia sits overlooking the Sethys River. Villagers collect clay from the riverbanks for the kilns of the imperial southlands.
chinese_text: 摩雷尼亚俯瞰着塞堤斯河，位于通往吕卡里亚谷的低矮入口处。村民们在河畔收集黏土，供应帝国南方的窑炉。

english_text: Sestadaim sits on the western side of the great Ornian Rock, looking over the dry Plain of Ichala. Some say the vultures for which the rock is named once gathered here to feast on the bodies of those who died working the local salt mines.
chinese_text: 塞斯塔代姆坐落于奥尼石山——吕卡里亚谷中央出露的一块巨岩的西侧。有人说这座石山得名自聚集于此饱餐死尸的秃鹫，而那些人死前还在当地的盐矿场工作。

english_text: Chanopsis sits near the headwaters of the Sethys River. Wheat grows well on the sun-baked slopes of the valley.
chinese_text: 卡诺普西斯依着密泽亚德高原上的塞堤斯河源头而建。小麦在这片阳光充足的平原上长势喜人。

english_text: Garontor gives its name to the straits that join the Gulf of Charas and the inland Perassic Sea, the Gates of Garontor. Coastal meadows, where tall grasses tolerant of the ocean salt-spray thrive, support the rearing of fine horses.
chinese_text: 位于沙拉斯湾和珀拉斯内海间的海角以加隆托为名。沿海草甸茂盛，这些较高的草对海水盐质的耐受性不错，可用来饲养优良的马匹。

english_text: Thorios sits in the Temea Valley in the heart of Calradia. Ample rainfall, rich soil and the relatively warm inland climate ensure that the grain fields of this district feed much of the central empire.
chinese_text: 托里俄斯坐落于卡拉迪亚腹地的阿里斯河谷中。河水灌溉与相对温暖的内陆气候，确保了该地区与相邻的柏耳贡的小麦田高产，喂养了帝国中部的许多人。

english_text: Bergum sits in the Temea Valley in the heart of Calradia. Rich soil, ample rainfall and the warm inland climate ensure that the grain fields of this district feed much of the central empire.
chinese_text: 柏耳贡坐落于卡拉迪亚腹地的阿里斯河谷中。河水灌溉与相对温暖的内陆气候，确保了该地区与相邻的托里俄斯的小麦田高产，喂养了帝国中部的许多人。

english_text: Onica lies in the Iltaric Hills, north of the Perassic Sea. The slopes of this district are terraced with vineyards, producing a dry wine popular throughout the Empire.
chinese_text: 俄尼卡坐落于珀拉斯海北岸。该地区的山丘上遍布梯田葡萄园，出产的干型葡萄酒在帝国各地广受欢迎。

english_text: Thractorae sits on the hills above a small bay that feeds into the larger Gulf of Charas. Oaks grow thick around the streams running down to the sea, allowing hogs to forage acorns and roots.
chinese_text: 色雷刻托坐落于汇入沙拉斯湾的一片小海湾旁。此地受南方热风的吹拂和山泉的滋润，被帝国的地主们用来进行椰枣树的试验性种植。

english_text: Veron lies on the Gavys River, the westernmost tributary of the Aminys. The hills above the town are lined with vineyards which thrive in the well-drained, sandy soil.
chinese_text: 维戎位于乌卡利翁地块的丘陵地带，靠近伽律斯河的源头处。小镇上方的山丘上种着葡萄，这些葡萄在排水良好的沙质土壤上茁壮成长。

english_text: Goleryn sits in the warm valley of the Gavys, where the river brushes by an outcrop of the Epiric Hills. Sheep-raising is a way of life in these parts, as is sheep-rustling.
chinese_text: 戈勒林坐落于温暖而橡树繁茂的埃皮尔山丘上，靠近瓦兰迪亚与巴旦尼亚的边境交界处。养羊在该地区算是一种生计，偷羊亦然。

english_text: Gersegos sits on a northern spur of the great basalt plutonic slab of Mount Erithrys. Villagers have sunk mines into the cliffs that overlook the village, extracting silver and other precious metals.
chinese_text: 革耳塞戈斯坐落于分割库耳西翁峭壁与德律亚山脉的弥戎河谷中。村民们在俯瞰村庄的一个山嘴上开了矿，提炼出银与其他贵金属。

english_text: Usek sits atop an escarpment of the Akkan Hills on the eastern shores of Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. The villagers, who until recently were nomads, raise sheep known for the long, fine wool.
chinese_text: 乌赛克村坐落于库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖东岸的阿克坎丘陵之下。这里的村民不久前还过着游牧生活，他们养的绵羊身上的羊毛又长又好。

english_text: Akiser sits in the southern reaches of the Akkan Hills. The land here is exceptionally broken and weathered, revealing seams of iron in the sides of the gullies and ravines.
chinese_text: 阿契赛尔位于阿克坎丘陵的南端。该地土壤的破碎风化程度十分严重，铁矿层在沟壑间显露出来。

english_text: The village of Hakkun sits beneath the escarpment of the Akkan Hills. The people of these parts have long mined silver from the mountains, a trade that the Khuzait khans were happy to encourage when they conquered this region.
chinese_text: 哈坤村坐落在阿克坎丘陵的悬崖上。这里的人们长期在山中开采银矿，库赛特征服该地区后，历代可汗对该行业也乐于支持。

english_text: Tepes sits in forested lowlands between the Devseg plateau and the lake that the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. This district specializes in the harvest of timber, which is dragged by oxen to the water and then floated to the lake towns.
chinese_text: 泰佩斯村俯瞰着喀拉卡孜河的一条支流，喀拉卡孜河自北方流入帝国人称作塔奈西斯的达那孜海。该地区盛产木材，人们顺流而下，将木材销往湖边的城镇。

english_text: Dinar lies in the far north of the Khuzait confederacy, along the Karakaz River. Here, tribes recently arrived from the steppe have intermarried with refugees pushed south from the Jumne valley by recent Nord expansion. The villagers herd sheep out on the open grassland of the steppe.
chinese_text: 迪纳尔位于库赛特部落联盟的极北之地，沿着喀拉卡孜河而建。这里几乎没有树木和山丘，无法抵御从东北草原沿冰冻的河面吹来的寒风，因此该地出产的羊毛异常浓密。

english_text: The villagers of Simira raise cattle by the grassy shores of the Tiagys River, known to the Khuzaits as the Teyagh. The river here still runs fast after its descent from the hills, and in springtime the villagers have learned to watch closely for signs of a flood that will force them to get their herds to higher ground.
chinese_text: 西米拉位于德夫赛格高原的东侧，由此再往东就进入了大草海。当地村民们饲养着能忍受寒冬酷暑的牛。

english_text: Kaysar sits in the north and east of the lands ruled by the Khuzaits, in the valley of the Karakaz River. This district is snowbound for much of the year, but villagers still raise herds of cattle bred to withstand the icy winds coming downriver from the north.
chinese_text: 开撒尔位于库赛特领土的东北方，在喀拉卡孜河谷里。该地区几乎终年积雪，但村民们仍饲养着受得了顺流自北方吹来的寒风的牛群。

english_text: Payam lies alongside the Davana River in the cold north of the Khuzait lands, not far from where it joins with the Karakaz and runs down to the sea. Though the land is snowbound much of the year, the villagers sow wheat and barley as soon as the melt starts, taking in a good crop before the autumn.
chinese_text: 帕亚木位于库赛特领土的寒冷北方，沿着喀拉卡孜河而建。尽管当地几乎终年积雪，但村民们在土地刚解冻时就播种小麦、大麦，所以秋收还不错。

english_text: Ustokol sits on the windswept Kachyar Peninsula, between the Battanian and Byalic seas. Hardy northern cattle have been bred to eat the short grasses that grow among the rocks, supplemented by sea-kelp in hard times.
chinese_text: 乌斯托科坐落于瓦尔切格湾与比亚里海之间当风的卡恰尔半岛。当地人饲养的耐寒北方牛会在石缝间找小草吃，困难时期则补充一些海藻。

english_text: Mazhadan sits on the forested western shores of Lake Laconis. Villagers grow flax in the muddy valleys between the hills.
chinese_text: 马扎丹靠近伽尔喀斯河的源头，在拉科尼斯湖的正西方。这片湿冷之地的村民们会在泥泞的山谷里种植亚麻。

english_text: Nevyansk sits at the foot of a fortified outcrop that the Sturgians call Minador. The towers that stand today are used by the Sturgians to keep watch over the rich but vulnerable wheatfields in these borderlands. Beneath the Sturgian walls however are foundations laid when the fortress was known by its Battanian name, Mynad Rhyfel, the hill of war, and the Sturgians have no doubt that their neighbors to the west would very much like to take it back.
chinese_text: 涅维扬斯克坐落于俯瞰瓦尔切格湾的一处平坦山角上。当地气候寒冷，但自山上流下的地表水带来了肥沃的土壤，村民们会种植黑麦、大麦等耐寒作物。

english_text: Dnin sits on pastures overlooking the great bay that the Sturgians call the Battanian Sea. Horses graze on the heights, glancing down occasionally at the trading longships and fishing boats passing beneath them.
chinese_text: 德宁位于俯瞰瓦尔切格湾狭窄处的牧草地上。马儿们在高地吃草，偶尔瞥一眼下面经过的长船和小渔船。

english_text: Kranirog sits near a ridge at the beginning of the Kachyar Peninsula. The villagers in these parts are expert trappers, hunting marten, fox and rabbit for the rich pelts much in demand in the south.
chinese_text: 克拉尼罗格位于俯瞰加尔察河的开阔林谷内。此地的村民们是捕猎好手，猎取貂、狐狸和兔子的毛皮以供应南方的大量需求。

english_text: Ismilkorg sits in the Irkaria hill country between Lake Laconis and the gulf that the Sturgians call the Battanian Sea. The people here are mostly cattle-herders as well as cattle-rustlers, and have long traded raids with the imperial frontier villages to the south and Battanians to the west.
chinese_text: 伊斯米尔科格坐落于弥戎河的两条小支流——加尔察河与瓦斯特拉河间长满草的低地上。当地人大多既养牛又偷牛，并长期劫掠东边的帝国边境村庄和西边的巴旦尼亚人。

english_text: Ov is a recently settled Sturgian colony on the high wooded slopes over the Mazapor estuary. Sturgians came to this region in search of furs, but game has been driven further west into yet-unsettled lands and these days the residents raise flax in meadows amids the woods.
chinese_text: 奥夫是伊卡拉荒原——拉科尼斯湖西北方的森林里一处较新的斯特吉亚殖民地。村民们最初定居于此是为了寻找毛皮，但猎物大多被驱赶到森林深处，如今他们在沼泽林地里种植亚麻。

english_text: Ferkh lies in a valley at the western edge of the Chertyg Mountains. It serves as a base for traders venturing further into the highlands, braving cold, wolves and the sometimes-hostile, sometimes-friendly peoples of the woods in pursuit of fur, the bounty of the northlands.
chinese_text: 费赫位于伊卡拉荒原——拉科尼斯湖西北方森林的北部边缘处。它是冒险进入森林深处的商贩的据点，那些人需要面对严寒与狼群，以及寻求毛皮、喜怒无常的林中居民，还有北地的赏金猎人。

english_text: Takor is a cattle-raising village in the heart of the Chertyg Mountains. The term 'Takorski' is used by other Sturgians to refer to someone whose speech is unintelligible. Above the village, small wisps of smoke show where wandering Vakken forest dwellers make their temporary fields, sowing them for one or two seasons before moving elsewhere.
chinese_text: 塔科尔是一座养牛村，位于巴旦尼亚人称作“米纳德·里韦尔”，即“战争之山”的山口处。他们的帝国与斯特吉亚邻居们则称之为“弥那多耳”。这是连通荒凉北方与相对稳定的帝国疆土的主要通道之一，无论对商贸还是对劫掠来讲。

english_text: Urikskala sits on a bluff overlooking the eastern shores of Lake Laconis. The eastern edge of the lake is rich with fish, including massive pike and sturgeon that breed in the nearby Karakaz estuary.
chinese_text: 乌里克斯卡拉位于伊勒坦运输线上，那是一张由冰川湖构成的网络，拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间往来的长船可以在上面拖动与航行。村民们在浅水处捕获带刺的鲈鱼和螯虾，将其风干后卖给旅行者们。

english_text: Vladiv lies on a plain to the northeast of Mount Iltan. The hardy cattle of this region have learned to dig through thick winter snows in search of grass to sustain them until the spring.
chinese_text: 弗拉基夫坐落于伊勒坦山脚下寒冷阴暗的林谷中。该地区的耐寒牛在冬季会挖开厚厚的积雪找草吃，以此熬到春天。

english_text: Usanc sits on the slopes of the Epiric Hills, overlooking the Gulf of Charas. This warm southern land supports the growing of olive trees.
chinese_text: 于桑克坐落于汇入沙拉斯湾的一片小海湾旁。这片温暖的南方土地很适合种植橄榄树。

english_text: Ferton sits at the base of the Biscan Hills. This warm coast, fragrant with lavender and thyme, is well-suited to the growing of olives..
chinese_text: 费顿在蜿蜒曲折的特朗河的一个拐角处，离通往比斯坎丘陵的山口不远。村民们在温暖、干燥的一侧山坡上种植橄榄。

english_text: Tirby looks out onto the cold misty waters that lie off of the Ebor peninsula. The low-lying lands on the northern side of the Ebor are suited to the growing of flax.
chinese_text: 蒂尔比位于埃博半岛附近寒冷多雾的水域旁。埃博北边的低洼地带适合种植亚麻。

english_text: Deriat sits just inland of the Bay of Drapand. Villagers here raise hogs, herding them to the nearby highlands to forage for nuts and roots.
chinese_text: 德里亚特位于瓦尔切格湾与埃博半岛的山脊之间。当地村民会在山上捕获河狸与水貂，有时会在海湾水域捉海豹。

english_text: Verecsand sits in the lowlands of the Trand valley. Villagers here grow wheat in the gentle downs by the meandering river.
chinese_text: 韦雷克桑位于一片小而深的内陆湖——奥克斯湖的水域旁。当地村民在湖边平坦的草原上种植小麦。

english_text: Baq lies slightly inland from the Bahr al-Yeshm sea, beneath the great granite outcrop of the Jabal Tamar. The seawinds bring the uplands here just enough rain to support the cultivation of olive trees.
chinese_text: 巴格位于耶什姆海稍向内陆处，巨大的花岗岩露头山——塔玛尔山脚下。海风为这里的高地带来的雨水刚好够用来种些橄榄树。

english_text: Fanab lies at the feet of the granite outcrop known as the Jabal Tamar, on the peninsula between the bay that the Aserai call the Bay of Shariz and the inner sea of the Bahr al-Yeshm.  The seawinds bring just enough rain to support the cultivation of olive trees.
chinese_text: 法纳卜坐落于阿塞莱人称作沙瑞兹的海湾与耶什姆内海间的一个低矮的海角上。海风带来的雨水刚好够用来种些橄榄树。

english_text: Hiblet sits on the peninsula between the gulf that the Aserai call the Bay of Shariz, and the sea they call the Bahr al-Yeshm. The rainclouds that sweep across this land drop sufficient water to fill the village's cisterns and irrigate its date-palm gardens.
chinese_text: 希卜莱特坐落于一座名为塔玛尔山的巨大花岗岩露头山脚下。人们将石缝里积蓄的雨水转移至村里的椰枣园。

english_text: Abu Khih is the southernmost village of the Aserai sultanate in the valley of the Tiagys. The lands here are dotted with crumbling brick towers, the ruins of cities that once thrived here under the Darshi shahs, before steppe nomads came and broke the levees that tamed the river. Years of devastating floods, followed by famines, reduced the population of this land to a fraction of what it once was.
chinese_text: 艾布·希位于流向南方不毛之地的凯勒斯河畔。这附近的土地原先是条古河床，现在已经贫瘠与碱化，不过椰枣树仍能在此生长。

english_text: Hoqqa sits besides the meandering waters of the Tiyagis plain. Villagers grow crops close to the river, but the land quickly gives way to desert-steppe. Barren most of the year except for scrub, it is covered in grass and flowers in the spring and is fine grazing for horses.
chinese_text: 胡加位于阿塞莱的远东之地，蒂亚具斯河畔。这片土地基本是荒漠草原，一年内大部分时间都很贫瘠，仅有一些灌木丛，不过春天这里会长出适合马儿吃的花草。

english_text: Abba sits in a broad wadi of the Jarjara Escarpment, close to the outlet where the rains that fall once every few years rush down to the sea. Runoff from the hills is trapped underground here, sustaining an oasis. Wheat thrives in the fields and gardens.
chinese_text: 阿卜巴坐落于沙漠深处的边缘处，在杰尔贾赖峭壁向陆侧的山脚下。山上流下的径流在地下积蓄，形成维持绿洲的泉水，小麦在耕地与田园里茁壮成长。

english_text: Hunab lies in the Sahel al-Wuhush, the Plain of Beasts, weathered mesas of the Jarjara Escarpment. Although the name comes from the mysterious petroglyphs of animals found caved throughout the valley, it could just as well refer to the fine steeds reared today, fed on the lush if short-lasting crop of grass that covers the slopes in the spring.
chinese_text: 侯纳卜坐落于杰尔贾赖峭壁风化台地下的一座干谷中。当地村民们利用春天覆盖山坡的短暂而繁茂的青草来饲养马匹。

english_text: Qablab sits on a bluff of the rust-red Jabal Ashabi hills, overlooking the towers and harbor of Razih. Every morning, villagers leave the jasmine- and thyme-scented hills to descend to the thick air of the coast, where they harvest salt from artificial lagoons.
chinese_text: 加卜拉卜坐落于珀拉斯海南岸一片开阔的海湾边。地势低洼的海岸线非常适合建设盐田。

english_text: Mussum sits near the eastern coast of the Perassic Sea, which the Aserai call the Bahr al-Yeshm. Here, the deserts of the far south give way to desert-steppe with scattered acacia and scrub. The villagers here sink wells to water their groves of date palms.
chinese_text: 穆苏姆靠近耶什姆海的东岸，阿塞莱的沙漠在这里为零星散布着金合欢树与灌木丛的荒漠草原所替代。当地村民们挖井取水来灌溉椰枣树林。

english_text: Mahloul in the Sahal al-Wuhush, the Plain of Beasts, that cuts through the Jarjara Escarpment south of the Bahr al-Yeshm. The valley takes its name from the mysterious petroglyphys of hoofed and horned animals carved on boulders scattered about. Groundwater provides just enough water to grow crops for subsistence, while the village makes its money from rearing horses on the rich grass that grows in clefts in the escarpment after the spring rains.
chinese_text: 马赫卢勒坐落于耶什姆海南侧的沙漠草原，在杰尔贾赖峭壁和阿沙卜山之间的开阔峡谷中。地下水刚好够用来种植维持生计的作物，而村民们也会在春雨季节过后放牧于阿沙比山上的丰草原，靠养马来赚点钱财。

english_text: Liwas sits in the seaward end of the Sahal al-Wuhush, the Plain of Beasts. This broad valley runs between the Jabal Minshar, a sharp sandstone ridge near the coast, and the inland mesas of the Jarjara escarpment. Although the valleys name comes from the mysterious petroglyphs found here of horned and hoofed animals, it could just as well refer to the splendid horses that are grazed on the desert's short-lived but rich spring grasses.
chinese_text: 利瓦斯坐落于耶什姆海南边的一座宽阔山谷内。当地农田有限，最出名的还是用荒漠上短命而肥美的春草喂养的马匹。

english_text: Waltas sits by the Bay of Qasira, an inlet of the sea that the Aserai call the Bahr al-Yeshm. The ridges of the nearby Jabal Ashabi mountains catch rainclouds coming off the Bahr al-Yeshm sea, allowing for the growing of wheat.
chinese_text: 瓦勒塔斯傍着意为“翡翠之海”的拜赫尔·耶什姆。这里的低地非常适合种植亚麻。

english_text: Mijayit lies off of the estuary of the Damar river as it reaches the Bahr al-Yeshm sea. The rich silt deposits left by the river make this one of the most fertile regions and densely populated regions of the Aserai lands.
chinese_text: 达玛尔河一直蜿蜒流淌至耶什姆海，而米贾伊特就坐落于河口旁。河流携带的淤泥沉积于此，使这里成为了阿塞莱土地最肥沃的地区之一。

english_text: Nahlan sits on the floodplain of the Damar River as it cuts through the Jarjara Escarpment. This soil, refreshed yearly by the silt of the flooding river, produces bountiful crops of wheat.
chinese_text: 纳赫兰坐落于杰尔贾赖峭壁被达玛尔河分割形成的冲积平原上。当地的土壤每年都会因洪流带来的淤泥而恢复肥力，所以小麦产量很高。

english_text: Bait Hatif lies in one of the wadis that are cut through the Jarjara Escarpment by the rare but fierce desert rains. Wells tap the groundwater here and allow subsistence farming, but the wealth of the land comes from the fine horses raised on the grasses that grow on the heights in the spring.
chinese_text: 拜特·哈提夫坐落于杰尔贾赖峭壁被达玛尔河分割形成的冲积平原上。该地区的石质土壤限制了灌溉效果，不过山上的春草可以让马儿茁壮成长。

english_text: Zalm sits at the Scorched Gates, where the Damar River descends from the Nahasa Desert and starts its journey through the Jarjara Escarpment. The silt brought by the river produces bountiful crops of wheat.
chinese_text: 扎勒姆坐落于枯焦之门，达玛尔河在此处从纳哈撒沙漠发源并穿过杰尔贾赖峭壁。河水携带的淤泥使得当地小麦的收成很好。

english_text: Ezbet Nahul lies in the middle of the Khisba, a small but rich coastal plain protected from the deserts by the Jabal Minshar. Villagers tap every source of available freshwater, from cisterns, wells in the ground, or rain-traps in the hills, to devote to the growing of wheat to feed nearby Qasira.
chinese_text: 艾兹贝特·纳胡勒位于俯瞰着阿塞莱人称作“拜赫尔·耶什姆”，即“翡翠之海”一处多岩山角上。石缝间积蓄的地下水可从井里获取，用来灌溉村里的小麦田。

english_text: Dalmengus sits by the side of the Llyn Tywal, the dark lake at the center of the Uchalion massif. The flat, well-watered lands here are fertile and well-suited to wheat and barley.
chinese_text: 达尔门格斯位于泰瓦尔湖——即乌卡利翁地块中央的暗湖之畔。这里的土地平坦肥沃且雨水丰沛，很适合种植小麦与大麦。

english_text: Ebereth is one of several villages on the densely populated southern shores of the Llyn Tywal, the dark lake at the heart of the Battanian lands. The people here here grow grapes to make the sweet white wine of the Battanian lands.
chinese_text: 埃贝雷斯坐落于一处鞍状山脊上，一边是泰瓦尔湖，另一边则通往卡瓦尔谷的隘口。当地村民们种植葡萄来酿造巴旦尼亚地区甘甜的白葡萄酒。

english_text: Beglomuar sits at the crest of the Cafalcombe. The soil is thin and rocky, and there is little to recommend these lands other than the ore deposits in the hills and the bog-iron of the mountain marshes.
chinese_text: 贝格洛米艾位于乌卡利翁地块南边峭壁的一处角落里。除了山上的矿床与沼泽的沼铁矿之外，这里就没什么吸引人的地方了。

english_text: Ath Cafal sits near the head of the Cafalcombe, a steep valley that descends to the imperial lands. The villagers gather fine clay from local streambeds to trade to the potters of nearby towns.
chinese_text: 阿斯·卡瓦尔靠近卡瓦尔谷——通往帝国领土的陡峭山谷之起始端。山上奔流而下的小溪中可以收集到优质的黏土。

english_text: Diantogmail lies in winding valleys in hill country to the east of Llyn Tywal, the dark lake. There are a half-dozen local legends explaining how the region got its name, which means the 'Flight of the Stoat,' but no two of them match in any particulars. Villagers here gather clay from the lakeside for use by nearby artisans.
chinese_text: 迪安托格麦尔位于“林·泰瓦尔”，即“暗湖”之畔。有数种本地传说解释该地名字的由来——意为“白鼬之翔”，但没有任意两种版本的细节能对得上。这里的村民会从湖边收集黏土，供附近的工匠使用。

english_text: Morihig lies in the Morcomb, a valley on the western side of the Uchalion massif. The region is known for its production of wheat and barley.
chinese_text: 莫里希格坐落于乌卡利翁地块中部的一块盆地中。该地区以盛产小麦和大麦而闻名。

english_text: Imlagh lies below the heights of the Ailta Druin, overlooking the Muir Gal sea. The village specializes in white grapes for the making of the sweet Battanian wines.
chinese_text: 伊姆拉赫位于乌卡利翁地块中部起伏的丘陵上。这座村庄特产用来酿造巴旦尼亚甜葡萄酒的白葡萄。

english_text: Bog Beth sits in a forested glen at the seaward side of Ben Callach mountain. Villagers trap beavers, foxes and other fur-bearing animals in the dark, marshy woods.
chinese_text: 博格·贝斯坐落于乌卡利翁地块东部一座地势低矮的林谷中。村民们在阴暗的沼泽林地里用陷阱捕捉河狸、狐狸和其他毛皮兽。

english_text: Geunat Nal, the village where Nal left his head, is a fur-trapping village near the site of a duel famous in Battanian legend. The villagers are known for their skill as foresters, helping the nearby sea-fort of Car Banseth to guard the northern approaches to the Battanian heartland from Sturgian and other raiders.
chinese_text: 格纳特·纳尔是巴旦尼亚传说中决斗之地附近的一座村庄，据传纳尔在此留下了他的头颅。当地村民们以出色的护林人技能而闻名，他们帮助附近悬崖上的卡·班塞斯要塞抵御斯特吉亚人和其他掠夺者的攻击，保护着巴旦尼亚的腹地。

english_text: Tor Leiad, the hill of the full moon, lies beneath a wooded knoll in a small patch of Battanian lowland near Car Banseth. Villagers harvest the thick-growing forests of oak, yew and beech that grow on the heights above their homes. The woods here have been tended carefully by the Battanians for centuries, ensuring that there are always enough trees to harvest and sell for timber.
chinese_text: 托·莱阿德，满月之丘，坐落于巴旦尼亚北部的一座树木繁茂的小山丘下。当地村民们砍伐橡树、紫杉和山毛榉林。几百年来，巴旦尼亚人悉心照料着这些树木，保证木材一直足够采伐和贩卖。

english_text: Bryn Glas sits on the eastern shores of the Llyn Tywal. Villagers raise grapes on the slopes, making a strong, dark red wine highly valued by the Vlandians and the Empire.
chinese_text: 布林·格拉斯坐落于乌卡利翁地块东边的悬崖上。村民们在山坡上种植葡萄，酿造出浓郁的深红色葡萄酒，深受瓦兰迪亚人和帝国人的喜爱。

english_text: Andurn sits on a grassy down overlooking Llyn Tywal, the dark lake. The villagers of these parts tend the forests, harvesting beech, oak and yew for sale to the towns.
chinese_text: 安杜恩坐落于俯瞰“林·泰瓦尔”——即暗湖的山上裂口处。该地区的村民种植树木，采伐山毛榉、橡树和紫杉，再销往各城镇。

english_text: Swenryn gives its name to the waterfall that cascades down the cliffs at the eastern edge of the Uchalion. Horses graze in lush pastures fed by the mists.
chinese_text: 斯温林俯瞰着岩石大瀑布，它阻挡了泰瓦尔湖的黑暗水域，形成乌卡利翁中央的湖泊。马儿在激流与瀑布之上的草地上觅食。

english_text: Seordas sits in the lowlands at the eastern edge of the Battanian lands, at the foot of the Uchalion's cliffs. The land is watered by the tributaries of the Myr River and the soil is rich, but in wartime there are few natural protections against the maraudings of Sturgian and imperial raiders.
chinese_text: 肖尔达斯坐落于巴旦尼亚东部边境的低地，在乌卡利翁山崖脚下。附近的乌瑟莱姆要塞保护着该地暴露在外的农场，使其免受东边斯特吉亚强盗的袭击。

english_text: Durn sits just below the crags that form the crest of the Etircomb, the steep valley that climbs from the Vlandian coastal lowlands to the Uchalion massif. Villagers scrape mud from mountain creekbeds, carting it up the winding paths to the town of Pen Cannoc perched on the cliff above them.
chinese_text: 杜恩位于特朗河上游峡谷的下方。当水流平缓时，村民们从河边的水池和泥塘里刮取淤泥，沿着蜿蜒的小路把淤泥运到他们上方悬崖处的彭·坎诺克城。

english_text: Gainseth sits in dense woods that grow near the stronghold of Pen Cannoc. Villagers collect mud from the marshy ground for sale to the potters of Pen Cannoc.
chinese_text: 盖恩塞斯位于乌卡利翁地块的东部边界、莱恩诺丘陵下一座阴暗的林谷中。当地村民们在湿地里收集泥土，卖给彭·坎诺克的陶工。

english_text: Fenon Etir lies in the Etircomb, the steep valley that leads from the Vlandian coastal lowlands to the Uchalion massif. The trails to the village pass by mounds of slag, the detritus from centuries of mining the iron-rich ores of the nearby hills, exposed by the creeks that run down from the heights.
chinese_text: 韦农·埃蒂尔坐落于俯瞰特朗河支流——埃蒂尔河源头的一座露头山上。村庄下方，河水蜿蜒流淌于成堆的矿渣之间，这些矿渣是数百年来在附近山丘上开采富铁矿留下的残骸。

english_text: Inveth sits where the River Etir forms from streams that tumble down the Uchalion massif before reaching the coastal lowlands, where they feed into the Trand. The surrounding hillsides support the growing of wheat.
chinese_text: 因韦斯位于特朗河与埃蒂尔河从乌卡利翁地块翻滚而出处，这两条河汇合流入瓦兰迪亚中央的平原。该地周围环绕的丘陵适合种植小麦。

english_text: Stathymos lies by a tributary of the Miron River, north of the Dryatic Mountains. The nearby hills have several hot springs, whose faint whiff of sulfur has made Stathymos one of several villages in the Empire who claim to have once been plagued by dragons who were eventually slain by bold cataphracts.
chinese_text: 斯塔堤摩斯位于德律亚山脉高耸山脊下的一条狭长山谷中。高地的溪流灌溉着山坡上的沃土，使该地区成为了帝国北方的“粮仓”之一。

english_text: Dyopalis lies in a valley in the Lesser Dryatic Mountains. Despite the cold winters, the region's fertile soils make this district one of the breadbaskets of the northern Empire.
chinese_text: 底俄帕利斯位于德律亚山脉的一座山谷中。尽管冬季寒冷，但该地肥沃的土壤使其成为了北帝国重要的“粮仓”之一。

english_text: Alosea lies on the southern shores of Lake Laconis. The folk of this region live well off the pike and sturgeon of the lake.
chinese_text: 阿罗塞亚在拉科尼斯湖以西很远处，靠近狄亚特马湾的入口。当地人依靠湖中捕捞的梭子鱼和鲟鱼生活得很富足。

english_text: Jeracos sits in meadowland in the northern piedmont of the Dryatic Mountains. The slopes of the nearby hills are pierced with mineshafts. Despite centuries of use, they still yield ores from which silver can be extracted through various cunning techniques.
chinese_text: 耶拉科斯坐落于德律亚山脉北部山麓的草场上。已被开采了几个世纪的矿井仍然蕴藏着丰富的矿石，人们可以通过各种巧妙的技术从中提取银。

english_text: Enoisa sits by the cold, slow-moving River Nevys as it makes its way towards Lake Laconis. Wheat grows here, fed by the ample rains of the north.
chinese_text: “大地之眼”俄佛堤斯，德律亚山脉南部山区的一片深湖，岸边就是厄诺伊萨。从北方来的充足降水润泽着这里的小麦。传说此处是古帕拉人的圣地，他们认为这片湖是通往另一个世界的门户。

english_text: Aeoria sits in the fertile Vale of the Aris, where the river winds between parallel granite ridges. The dialect here is laced with words from Palaic, the language spoken in the center of the continent before the Empire came.
chinese_text: 艾俄里亚位于帝国腹地土壤肥沃的阿里斯谷。当地方言掺杂了帕拉语词汇，帝国人到来前大陆中央居民说的是帕拉语。

english_text: Crios sits besides the River Aris as it descends into the Ophthys, the dark pool that lies at the foot of Mount Tarnea. Shrines built by the ancient Palaic people, who believed the lake was a gateway to another worgendsd, can be found along its shores.
chinese_text: 克里俄斯位于德律亚山脉东边的石灰岩山脊上。高地土壤适合生长优质的马草。
