english_text: Potamis sits at the edge of the Temea Valley, near the foothills of the Dryatic Mountains. The people of these parts have raised cattle since pre-Calradic times, and its milk and butter are sought out by traders and travellers passing through the region.
chinese_text: 珀塔米斯坐落在德律亚山脉的一处低谷中。这里的人们自前卡拉德时代就开始养牛了，经过该地区的商贩和旅行者们很容易买到牛奶和黄油。

english_text: Nortanisa is a fishing village on the western shores of Lake Laconis. Villagers place nets and cages in the shallow edges of the lake and the nearby estuary of the Caracasos to catch roach, bream, perch, and crayfish.
chinese_text: 诺耳塔尼萨是拉科尼斯湖南岸的一座渔村。村民们在湖泊的浅滩放置渔网和渔笼，来捕获拟鲤、鲷鱼、鲈鱼和小龙虾。

english_text: Hetania sits beneath a low ridge in the Lesser Dryatic Mountains. As in many villages around here, the foresters of this region still speak the Dryatic languages of the tribes who lived here before the Empire came.
chinese_text: 赫塔尼亚坐落于德律亚山脉东北部的一个山嘴下。同这附近的许多村庄一样，当地的林农依然说着帕拉语。在帝国入侵之前，帕拉语是这里各部落所说的语言。

english_text: Vealos sits in a thickly wooded valley in the eastern end of the Myzead, the rugged highlands of the eastern Empire. Retired imperial officers have founded stud farms here, grazing their horses on the rich pasture on the slopes of the heights.
chinese_text: 威亚罗斯坐落于帝国东边德律亚山脉东侧的缓坡上。尽管山坡基本覆盖着山毛榉和橡树林，这里还是能产出很好的马草，而且此处自古以来就是帝国军马的育种地。

english_text: Orthra, a relatively recent settlement, was named by an imperial captain for its fine southward views over the Myzead, the mountainous highlands of the eastern empire. It was founded as a stud farm to breed imperial horses with steppe stock from the east, and continues to provide horses for the imperial cavalry.
chinese_text: 俄耳特拉是一座相对较年轻的定居点，得名自一位帝国将领，他于破晓时分在此东望，看到密泽亚德的美景后就命名了日后这座帝国东部的山村。这里是帝国的马匹育种场，从东方草原运来牧草，为帝国骑兵部队提供马匹。

english_text: Themys lies under a ridge of limestone crags in the Myzead, the mountainous highlands of the eastern Empire. The grasses on the rolling downs are well-suited to the raising of sheep.
chinese_text: 忒密斯位于帝国腹地的山区——密泽亚德的石灰岩峭壁之下。当地丘陵上生长的草非常适合养羊。

english_text: Samatha sits upon a sloping ridge in the highlands of the Myzead. The hillsides have been terraced to allow the growing of mulberry bushes. The leaves are harvested, placed in vats and fed to silkworms.
chinese_text: 萨马塔位于阳光普照的密泽亚德高地的一处斜坡上。山坡被改造成了梯田，方便种植桑树。人们采集这些桑叶，放到大桶里喂蚕。

english_text: Avasinton sits in a valley of the Myzead, the mountainous highlands of the eastern Empire. Villagers have cleared away the thickets and thornbrush of this region, including the pungent wormwood after which the village is named, to allow the growing of mulberry bushes, the leaves of which are harvested and fed to silkworms.
chinese_text: 阿瓦辛顿坐落于帝国中部山区密泽亚德荒凉的东端。村民们清理掉了这个地区的灌木丛和荆棘，包括刺鼻的艾草（该村庄曾以这种艾草为名），方便腾出地方种植桑树，然后收集桑叶养蚕。

english_text: Boreagora lies where the estuary of the Caracasos River reaches Lake Laconis. The lowlands here are suited to the growing of flax.
chinese_text: 玻瑞阿戈拉位于帝国寒冷的北方，被伊勒坦运输线的冰湖网络所包围。附近的帝国堡垒在水路上若隐若现，监视着斯特吉亚和库赛特的劫掠者。这里的低地很适合种植亚麻。

english_text: Caira sits in the humid plains east of Danustica. Here, the sea air of the Perassic is trapped by the Calsean Hills, creating a climate shunned by many other Calradians. For those used to the heat, however, the rich soils provide a good living, and the villagers are proud of their role guarding the frontier with the Aserai.
chinese_text: 恺拉坐落于被称为卡勒萨的河流、湖泊、潟湖交织的网络中。再往东一点的地方，就是相当贫瘠的碱性土，但在这里，卡勒萨河和蒂亚具斯河共同塑造的冲积平原可以种植小麦。

english_text: Polisia sits on the eastern end of the Thymian Hills. Villagers harvest salt from pans in a shallow inlet to their south, near the town of Danustica. They prefer to live up in the hills, however, away from the thick and fetid air and the mosquitos of the coast.
chinese_text: 波利西亚坐落于阿塞莱边境被称为卡勒萨的河湖交通网旁。村民们从西边的一片潟湖中采盐，那里被沙嘴分割前，曾是珀拉斯海的一片海湾。卡拉迪亚大陆的其他居民经过这片低地时都会绕道而走，因为这里的空气又浑又臭，但是当地人都对自己监视阿塞莱人的职责引以为傲。

english_text: Tegresos sits amid woodland on the eastern end of the Thymian Hills, close to the Aserai and Khuzait domains. Originally it was settled in defiance of imperial authority by the bands of fugitives and adventurers known as the Eleftheroi, but the archons of Danustica eventually awarded this settlement a proper charter in exchange for helping to guard the frontiers.
chinese_text: 泰格瑞索斯位于卡勒萨河北边，它勾勒出阿塞莱的边界，然后汇入湖泊、溪流和潟湖的交通网中。当地村民饲养着以沼泽里的草为食的绵羊。

english_text: The frontier village of Erebulos sits in woodland beneath the Calsean Hills. This village was settled by Eleftheroi, though it has since been integrated into the archonate of Danustica. Villagers scoop clay from creek-bottoms here, and keep watch for Aserai and Khuzait raiders trying to infliltrate the imperial frontiers through the woods.
chinese_text: 厄瑞玻洛斯位于一片潟湖旁，这片潟湖被最近形成的沙嘴所封闭前，曾是珀拉斯海的一部分。村民们从溪底挖出黏土，然后卖给达努提斯卡和附近城镇的陶窑。

english_text: The village of Atphynia lies in a valley in the Thymian Hills. The rocks here are speckled with sea-shells, while salt deposits lie in the valley, and villagers claim that this was once a bay of the sea uplifted by some great subterranean force.
chinese_text: 阿特费尼亚村靠近塞堤斯河口，再向下游河流随即分为三支，形成三河河谷。在塞堤斯河流入珀拉斯海的河口附近，村民们开出了盐田。

english_text: Gorcorys sits on the Gorea, the southernmost tributary of the Sethys River. The dark, well-watered soil here makes this region an imperial breadbasket.
chinese_text: 戈耳科律斯坐落于歌里亚河畔，那是塞堤斯河流经三河河谷最南端的支流。水量充沛的黑土使得这片地区成为了“帝国粮仓”。

english_text: Avalyps sits on the narrow but fertile shelf of land between the Perassic Sea and the Thymian Hills. The dark, well-watered soil here makes this region an imperial breadbasket.
chinese_text: 阿瓦吕普斯靠近卡勒萨河上游，位于南帝国海边的温暖山丘上。水量充沛的黑土使得这片地区成为了“帝国粮仓”。

english_text: Alision lies in a nook of the Thymian Hills, north of the Perassic Sea. The rocks of this basin are lined with seashells, a long source of fascination to imperial philosophers who debate whether the earth experienced periodic inundations or if different portions are raised and lowered over time.
chinese_text: 阿利西翁坐落于珀拉斯海北岸。当地渔业相当不景气，于是村民们在浅滩处建造了盐田。

english_text: Canoros sits in the plains north of the Perassic Sea. This land has been good horse country since even before the Empire came, furnishing the steeds of the Lycarean riders who routed several Calradian armies before their final defeat and absorption into the imperial cavalry.
chinese_text: 卡诺洛斯位于吕卡里亚平原平坦的南端。在帝国入侵前，该地就是一处很好的养马区，为吕卡里亚的骑手供应追逐卡拉德敌人的骏马，直到前者最终战败并被吸收进帝国骑兵部队。

english_text: Tevea sits by the banks of the River Sethys, south of the Ornian Rock. This great outcrop is named for the vultures who perch on its crags to keep watch on the hazy plains below. The low-lying riverlands are used by the villagers to grow flax.
chinese_text: 特维亚坐落于吕卡里亚谷中平地向奥尼石山基底缓慢爬升的中间地带。奥尼石山得名自栖息于峭壁之上，俯瞰着雾蒙蒙的平原的秃鹫。石山阴面下的洼地一年中大部分时间都保持湿润，是种植亚麻的良田。

english_text: Sagora sits on a low ridge overlooking the River Sethys. This district is one of the rockier and less fertile parts of the river valley, but the valley scrub still supports the grazing of sheep.
chinese_text: 萨戈拉坐落在吕卡里亚平原中央的一处低矮山脊上。该地区属于平原上岩石较多，较不肥沃的地方之一，但山谷的灌木丛仍可以供羊啃食。

english_text: Popsia lies on the eastern side of Mount Tarnea. Pelaic myth says that two gigantic brothers fought here and killed each other. Their sister Tarnea buried one in the depths of the Ophthys, the other in Lake Laconis, then transformed herself into the mountain to weep over their graves. Trees grow tall here in the cool shadows of the heights, and villagers harvest pines for sale as lumber.
chinese_text: 波普西亚坐落于奥尼石山与俄佛堤斯湖域之间窄窄的峡谷内。山间阴凉处的树木生得高大，村民们会砍伐松树并将木材卖出。

english_text: Canterion lies by the Sethys River, between the Ornian Rock and the Thymian Hills. The rich grasses have made this land good horse country since even before the coming of the Empire, and today the village gives its name to the chargers prized by the imperial nobility.
chinese_text: 坎忒里翁坐落于吕卡里亚平原东部，这里缓缓上升的坡地比平原的其他地方降雨更多。早在帝国入侵前，当地肥美的牧草就使其成为了一处优良的养马区。

english_text: Lanthas is one of the few settlements on the wide but barren Tanaetic Plain. This scrubland is good sheep country, but in a frontier district scoured by imperial fugitives, wild Eleftheroi riders and steppe nomads, the villagers here have learned to watch their flocks closely.
chinese_text: 兰塔斯躺在塔奈西斯湖以南的广阔平原上。这里是优质绵羊之乡，但这片地区会被帝国逃犯、自由民骑手和草原游牧民扫荡，当地村民已经学会了看紧羊群。

english_text: Lartusys lies on the eastern edge of the Tanaetic plain. The village sits near a deposit of salt, and salt springs occasionally bubble to the surface, feeding the legend that this was once a gateway to a haunted underground sea.
chinese_text: 拉耳图绪斯位于塔奈西斯湖的南端。村庄附近有座盐矿，盐泉偶尔会探出水面，让人们相信这就是传说中通往鬼怪聚集的地下海的门户。

english_text: Parasemnos sits in a low pass linking the Tanaeitic plain with coastal lowlands near Danustica. Silver mines have long existed in the hills, although the deposits are no longer as rich as they once were, and the villagers must use closely-guarded secret methods to extract the precious metal.
chinese_text: 帕拉森诺斯坐落于连通塔尼平原与卡勒萨河的低矮隘口旁。村民们从山口卡勒萨一侧山脊下的矿床中采盐。

english_text: Saldannis lies beneath bluffs overlooking the River Sethys. The fine soil of the hills makes for a sticky clay when it washes down to the river, much prized by the potters of the imperial south.
chinese_text: 萨尔丹尼斯位于石膏峭壁之下，俯瞰着塞堤斯河。山上的细土被水流冲刷下来形成黏土，这是能让帝国南方的陶工们两眼放光的东西。

english_text: Spotia lies east of the gently flowing Sethys River. The low rolling hills of this district comprise one of the breadbaskets of the Empire.
chinese_text: 斯珀提亚坐落于缓缓流淌的塞堤斯河畔。这里高低起伏的丘陵构成了帝国的“粮仓”之一。

english_text: Amycon lies on a ridge between the dry Plain of Ichala and the Sethys valley. The people of this land are sheep herders, known for their dry, salty cheese flavored with cumin.
chinese_text: 阿密孔坐落于奥兰石山与阿里斯河谷之间一片逶迤嶙峋的山脊之上。当地居民是牧羊人，以制作加孜然的咸味干酪而闻名。

english_text: Psotai sits on the western shores of Lake Tanaesis. The low-lying fields here are one of the major grain producing centers of the eastern frontier regions.
chinese_text: 索泰位于塔奈西斯湖南端。这里地势低洼，是东部边境地区的主要产粮地之一。

english_text: Primessos lies in the wooded upper reaches of the Aminys valley. Pigs, fed on the acorns of the southern oak trees, thrive in this climate.
chinese_text: 普里墨索斯位于伽维斯河谷树木繁茂的上游。当地气候适合饲养以南方橡树的橡子为食的猪。

english_text: Nideon sits on a low-lying spit of land where the Gavys, Aminys and Zeos rivers come together. Wine grapes grow on the gentle slopes rising up from the river valley.
chinese_text: 尼得翁坐落于深成岩构成的厄里特律斯山脚下，在泽俄斯河低洼的蜿蜒处。酿酒用的葡萄生长在河谷的缓坡上。

english_text: Tarcutis sits on the shores of the Perassic Sea. The sandy soil and morning mists, channeled by offshore islands, allows the growing of grapes overlooking the beaches.
chinese_text: 塔耳库提斯坐落于珀拉斯海岸。近海岛屿冲过来的沙壤和晨雾，让俯瞰沙滩的地方得以建起葡萄园。

english_text: Neocorys, the new village, sits in gently sloping land in the Temea Valley cleared only recently of forest. The local landowners have established stud farms, supplying horses to the imperial cavalry.
chinese_text: 涅俄科律斯是一个新村，位于特美亚山谷的一处缓坡上，该地最近才由一片森林开辟而成。当地地主们建了育种场，为帝国骑兵部队提供马匹。

english_text: Alsasos sits on a shelf of land at the west end of the Temea, a broad valley north of the Perassic sea. Though the climate is relatively dry here, artesian wells allow farmers to grow bountiful crops of wheat.
chinese_text: 阿尔萨索斯位于珀拉斯海北边的宽阔山谷——特美亚的西部。尽管当地气候相对干旱，但农民们依靠自流井水仍有很好的小麦收成。

english_text: Zeocorys lies at the foot of a low escarpment that bisects the Temea Valley. Though the climate is relatively dry here, artesian wells allow farmers to grow bountiful crops of wheat.
chinese_text: 泽俄科律斯位于伊勒塔尔丘陵脚下，沿着南帝国的海岸线而建。尽管当地气候相对干旱，但农民们依靠自流井水仍有很好的小麦收成。

english_text: Aegosca sits at the head of the Temea, a broad valley in southern Calradia. Though originally named for the goats that used to roam this region, the landowners have turned over the pastures to the raising of far more profitable horses.
chinese_text: 埃戈斯卡位于卡拉迪亚南部的宽阔山谷——特美亚的起始端。虽然该地区得名自过去漫步于此的山羊，但地主们已经在这片草场改养利润丰厚得多的马匹。

english_text: Dradios sits near a bend in the Zeos River. Here the meandering waters have left a rich deposit of silt that sustains one of the breadbaskets of the Empire.
chinese_text: 得拉狄俄斯坐落于自高地奔流而下的阿米尼斯河的支流——小阿米尼斯河畔。当地村民们将山上的径流改道，用以灌溉肥沃的麦地。

english_text: Arpotis lies close to where the Zeos and Gavys rivers join the Aminys and together reach the sea. This well-watered plain is one of the breadbaskets of the Empire.
chinese_text: 阿耳波提斯坐落于高崖之上，俯瞰着阿米尼斯河、伽维斯河和泽俄斯河的交汇处。山的两边是梯田，还建有蓄水池，收集来自海洋的雨云所携带的淡水。

english_text: Lysia sits on the promontory above the Gates of Garontor, the straits that link the Gulf of Charas with the Perassic. Salt is farmed from evaporation pans on the broad beaches that look out onto the gulf.
chinese_text: 珀拉斯内海汇入西海所经过的那条狭长海峡便以吕西亚为名。它位于珀拉斯海的一侧，附近宽阔的海滩用于建设盐田。

english_text: Garengolia lies near a rich vein of silver in the eastern end of the Epiric Hills. The Empire have minted its denars from these mines for centuries.
chinese_text: 伽伦戈利亚位于一条储藏丰富的银矿脉旁，俯瞰着伽维斯河。几个世纪以来，帝国一直用这里出产的银矿铸造第纳尔。

english_text: Elipa sits on the heights overlooking the Plain of Ichala, a sparsely populated ancient lake bed. The plain itself is dry and the soil saline, and is mostly empty grass and scrubland, but the heights above are fertile and receives ample rains.
chinese_text: 厄利帕坐落于阿里斯河谷上游。这片光照充足、水源丰沛的高地是帝国重要的“粮仓”之一。

english_text: Phasos sits amid rolling chalk uplands on the edge of the Temea Valley. The rich grass of the down is some of the best horse-breeding land in the Empire.
chinese_text: 法索斯位于特美亚与阿里斯河谷间高地起伏的白垩山丘中。低处肥美的牧草使这里成为了帝国最好的养马地之一。

english_text: Vathea sits high on the slopes of the Dryatic Mountains, facing across the valley to the great basalt slab of Mount Erithrys. The villagers mine iron from shafts sunk deep into the cliffs of the mountains.
chinese_text: 瓦忒亚坐落在德律亚山脉的高坡上，面朝的山谷对面便是巨大的玄武岩山——厄里特律斯山。村民们在陡岸上深挖竖井以开采铁矿。

english_text: Thersenion lies in the shadow of Mount Erithrys, a great basalt slab thrust up from the depths of the earth. The Gavys, Aminys amd Zeos rivers all come together in the plains beneath the mountain, making these lands one of the grain breadbaskets of the Empire.
chinese_text: 忒耳塞尼翁坐落在阿米尼斯河谷上游，在拔地而起的玄武岩巨山——厄里特律斯山之下。该地区是帝国的“粮仓”之一。

english_text: Leblenion sits in the rolling hills of the Temea Valley east of Mount Erithrys, a great basalt slab thrust up from the depths of the earth. This warm land is one of the grain breadbaskets of the Empire.
chinese_text: 勒布伦尼翁位于拔地而起的玄武岩巨山——厄里特律斯山下的阿米尼斯河旁。这个地区是帝国的“粮仓”之一。

english_text: Fisnar sits in the grasslands east of the Karakaz River. Snow-bound for much of the year, the spring grasses nonetheless sustain sizeable herds of sheep, the thick wool of which protects them from the bitter winter cold.
chinese_text: 菲斯纳尔位于喀拉卡孜河的支流——札罕河畔。该地几乎终年积雪，但春草仍养活了相当多的绵羊，羊身上厚厚的羊毛帮助它们抵御严酷的寒冬。

english_text: Ulaan sits where the land gently rises from the valley of the Karakaz River to the slopes of the Sulan Dag. The villagers, nomads who have recently been forced by the khans to settle, have learned to grow flax for their livelihoods.
chinese_text: 乌兰坐落于喀拉卡孜河的河谷中。当地村民都是被可汗强令定居没多久的游牧民，他们已经学会了在这片低洼的泥泞地上种植亚麻。

english_text: Kuruluk sits in the shadow of the peak known as Bars Dag. Though this valley is snowbound for much of the year, steppe ponies thrive on the spring grasses and in the winter dig through the snow for food, their thick coats protecting them from the icy blasts of wind. Villagers keep watch to protect them from the leopards for which the mountain is named.
chinese_text: 库鲁卢克位于喀拉卡孜河的支流——札罕河畔。尽管这片谷地几乎终年积雪，但草原小马仍靠吃春草和在冬天挖雪找食物的方式顽强生存，厚毛皮帮助它们抵御呼啸的刺骨寒风。

english_text: Asalig sits at the foot of the Sulan Dag mountains, dividing the northern Khuzait lands from the sparsely populated steppe to the east. Villagers raise horses in the lower slopes, keeping watch for the leopards that descend from the high peaks in the winter, when the game is scarce.
chinese_text: 阿萨利格坐落于德夫赛格高原之巅的巴尔思山脚下。村民们在相对低矮的山坡上养马，并时刻提防着雪豹——此山正是因此而得名。

english_text: Karakalat lies at the southern end of the Akkan Hills. Until recently, this land was dominated by nomads, and it is still famous as a breeding ground for horses.
chinese_text: 喀拉卡拉特位于德夫赛格高原东部平缓边缘的一处盆地内。不久前，这片土地还被游牧民族支配着，当地如今仍以繁育良马而闻名 。

english_text: Tismil sits on the Ozu River, which drains the southern end of the Devseg plateau. The region is a center of horse-raising, as noyans seek to breed new larger warhorses that still retain the hardiness and adaptability of their ancestors' steppe ponies.
chinese_text: 帖斯密勒位于发源自德夫赛格高原南端的斡祖河畔。当地居民是牧羊人，由于历代可汗对马匪的打击清剿，他们得以在库赛特的强权统治下安稳生活。

english_text: Gereden lies amid the foothills of the Kohi Rohini, the mountains of the dawn, near the headwaters of the Kizil Tayegh River. The clay from this region, known for its reddish tint, is highly valued by the artisans of Odokh and other nearby towns.
chinese_text: 格烈登及其附属村庄一直外延至德夫赛格高原的南端，靠近斡祖河与帖牙合河的交汇处。虽然地形崎岖，但这里以山涧中产出的高品质黏土而闻名。

english_text: The fishing village of Shapeshte sits on a bay in Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. Carp and catfish were introduced to the gentle murky waters of the lakeshore back when these lands were controlled by the Empire, and today make up the majority of the fishermen's catch.
chinese_text: 沙佩什特位于札罕河与喀拉卡孜河的交汇处。村民们靠开采附近的盐矿谋生。

english_text: The village of Mazen sits on the northern end of Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. The northern winters here are tempered by the lake, and the villagers raise mulberry trees here to feed silkworms.
chinese_text: 渔村马津坐落于库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖的北端。村民们在喀拉卡孜河附近布下渔网，捕捉往返于湖中的各种鱼类。

english_text: Mivanjan sits near an escarpment of the Akkan Hills, which marks the western border of the Devseg plateau. Villagers, who not long ago still lived a nomadic lifestyle, raise sheep in the foothills.
chinese_text: 米万占坐落于德夫赛格高原东边的速仑山脚下。不久前，村民们还过着游牧生活，如今却在山麓小丘饲养绵羊。

english_text: Kamshar sits beneath a low range of hills separating Lake Tanaesis from the western tributaries of the Tayegh River. by Villagers collect clay from the riverbed for sale to the potters of Chaikand and other towns.
chinese_text: 喀木沙位于库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖畔。当地渔业不发达，但村民们在湖边收集到了黏土，卖给柴坎和其他城镇的陶工。

english_text: Okhutan is a village at the center of a wheat-growing district on a narrow stretch of plain between the Akkan Hills and Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea.
chinese_text: 奥胡坦是一座位于小麦种植区中央的村庄，地处库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖与阿克坎丘陵之间的狭长平原。

english_text: Ispantar is a village on a rocky spur of the Akkan Hills overlooking Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. The villagers here make most of their income from the raising of sheep.
chinese_text: 依斯潘塔尔位于阿克坎丘陵的一处多岩山嘴上，俯瞰着库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖。当地村民的主要收入来源是养羊。

english_text: Pabastan sits in the narrow plain between the Akkan Hills and Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. This land is fine country for wheat.
chinese_text: 帕巴斯坦坐落于阿克坎丘陵与库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖之间的狭长平原上。这是个种植小麦的好地方。

english_text: Nutyuk sits in the plains of the upper Tiagys River, known by the Khuzaits as the Tayegh. The villagers here, mostly recently settled nomads, raise sheep like their ancestors.
chinese_text: 努丘克位于一片露头岩山脉之下，该山的达西语名为柯希·罗希尼，即黎明山脉。当地村民多是新近定居的游牧民，他们像祖先一样饲养绵羊。

english_text: Danara sits near the source of the headwaters of the Tiagys River in the foothills of the Kohi Rohini, the mountains of the dawn. Salt and sulfur springs flow out of fissures in the rock here, giving the waters of the river an acrid taste until, further down, they are diluted by other creeks and streams.
chinese_text: 达纳拉位于库赛特人称作昌尕淖尔的不解渴的盐湖旁。当地村民们从苦涩的湖水中提取盐。

english_text: Kohi Ajik lies in a valley at the foot of the so-called Lover's Mountain, from which its name derives. To its east spring the headwaters of the Ozu River, one of the sources of the mighty Tiagys.
chinese_text: 柯希·阿吉克位于所谓“恋人山”脚下的一条狭窄干旱的峡谷中，该地名字也源自此山。当地人从东边的游牧民那里采购马匹，然后转手卖给城镇里的库赛特贵族。

english_text: Rodobas, the house of Obas, is named for a long-dead Sturgian hill chieftain. Perched high on a ridge overlooking the rolling hills of Irkaria, it adjoins one of the few remaining virgin forests of this once-wild land. The village serves as a base for trappers looking for furs in the primeval gloom of the great trees.
chinese_text: 罗多巴斯，“奥巴斯之屋”，得名自山上的一位亡故已久的斯特吉亚酋长。该村坐落在俯瞰伊卡拉荒原的山脊上，去山下黑暗的森林中猎取毛皮的猎人们将这里作为基地。

english_text: Forin sits on grassy downs overlooking a tributary of the Miron River, on the edge of the wild forests of eastern Irkaria. Landowners here have turned forest-land into pasture for horses.
chinese_text: 福林坐落于伊卡拉荒原边加尔察河附近的黑麦和大麦田旁。这里的地主把林地变成了马匹的牧场。

english_text: Safna in a valley in the rugged Chertyg Mountains. Villagers grow barley here, using it to make dumplings from the meat of mountain cattle that is sold in the markets of nearby towns.
chinese_text: 萨夫纳坐落于俯瞰激流的高耸山脊上，激流连接了拉科尼斯湖与狭窄的马佐波尔湾。村民们在靠近海崖的内陆种植小麦，那里的土地可以免受盐风的侵袭。

english_text: Marabrot sits on a high rocky ridge between the Mazapor Estuary and the Byalic Sea. This harsh land would probably not be settled where it not for the rich iron deposits in the hills.
chinese_text: 马拉布罗特坐落于马佐波尔湾与比亚里海之间高耸的多岩山脊上。这片苦寒之地要是没有山上丰富的铁矿，估计就不会有人定居于此。

english_text: Dvorusta is a fishing village on the northern shores of Lake Laconis. The water is cold and pure here, thanks to the streams running down from the Chernyg mountains, and the village fishermen take in a rich catch of freshwater lake fish.
chinese_text: 德沃鲁斯塔是一座渔村，俯瞰着连接瓦尔切格湾和拉科尼斯湖的激流。村民们在黎明时分沿着悬崖一路走下去，捕捉跃过岩石的鲑鱼，还有海里的鲱鱼和鳕鱼。

english_text: Chornobas, or Blackwood, sits in lands recently cleared from the forests in the hills of Irkaria. The villagers grow rye and barley to feed the booming port city of Omor. To the northeast, the lands for the most part remain wooded, although small wisps of smoke show where Sturgian settlers are beginning to cut down trees and sow fields.
chinese_text: 乔诺巴斯，或“黑树林”，坐落于由森林开辟出的一片土地上，俯瞰着弥戎河倾入拉科尼斯湖的大瀑布。村民们在瀑布旁水雾弥漫的田里种植黑麦与大麦。

english_text: Skorin lies in the heart of Irkaria, a patchwork of grassy downs and forests between the Battanian Sea and Lake Laconis. Villagers comb the remaining woods of these once-wild lands for signs of marten, mink, rabbit and other game, the fur of which is much valued by the merchants and magnates of northern Calradia.
chinese_text: 斯科林坐落于将佳托姆湾与拉科尼斯湖分割开的一个海角上。村民们在狭窄的海湾水域里捕捞淡水比目鱼，还在主湖区捕获梭鱼等更大的水产动物。

english_text: Glavstrom sits on the eastern shores of the Byalic Sea. The craggy shores here are thick with rockfish, which the villagers catch with nets despite the turbulence of the waters.
chinese_text: 格拉夫斯特伦坐落于东卡拉迪亚的一座峻峭险峰——伊勒坦山脚下，这座山得名自草原民族的一位神灵。这片荒野上有许多毛皮兽，如貂、狐狸、兔子等。

english_text: Omkany in the heart of the icy Chertyg Mountains. Villagers in this district raise hogs, curing their fat with salt and in garlic and selling it throughout the northlands.
chinese_text: 奥姆卡尼坐落于拉科尼斯湖畔与冰雪覆盖的车尔特格山脉之间。该地区的村民们饲养猪，并用盐和蒜腌制猪肥肉，销往北地各处。

english_text: Yangutum sits in a nook of the Chertyg Mountains near the north shores of Lake Laconis. The foresters harvest oak, elm and other hardwoods from the mountainsides.
chinese_text: 扬古图姆位于拉科尼斯湖北岸车尔特格山脉的一处角落。林务员们从山腰砍伐橡树、榆树和其他硬木。

english_text: Visibrot is a sheep-rearing village on the lower slopes of Mount Iltan. Though this region is cold and remote, its importance as a trade juncture between Lakes Laconis and Tanaesis, between the Empire and the steppe, mean that it is relatively densely populated.
chinese_text: 维西布罗特是伊勒坦山缓坡上的一座养羊村，正好位于人称伊勒坦运输线的冰湖网络下。尽管该地区寒冷偏僻，但它作为拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间，帝国和草原之间贸易节点的重要性，仍使其拥有了相对稠密的人口。

english_text: Bukits sits on the eastern slopes of Mount Iltan. Villagers raise highland cattle here, bred to withstand the icy gusts that tear down the mountain.
chinese_text: 布基茨坐落于库赛特边境上伊勒坦山的东坡。这里的村民饲养一种高原牛，该品种可以抵御从山上吹来的刺骨寒风。

english_text: Alov overlooks the Iltan portages, a series of crossings over the Karakaz and Davana rivers. Villagers cultivate rye and barley on slopes leading down to the river, and the rich black soil of the region compensates for the long winters and short growing season.
chinese_text: 阿洛夫位于名为伊勒坦运输线的冰湖网络边缘处。村民们在俯瞰湖泊的高地上种植黑麦与大麦，肥沃的黑土补偿了当地漫长的冬季和短暂的生长期。

english_text: Radakmed sits on the coasts of the Byalic Sea. Many of the families in the region trace their roots to Nords who migrated south, or Vakken who gave up their nomadic lives in the woods. Whatever lands they may have come from, the people of Radakmed have now taken to the sea. Their wanderlust not yet slacked, they sail far to the north each summer to hunt walrus, for flesh to eat, ivory to trade, and blubber to light lamps on long winter nights.
chinese_text: 拉达克梅德坐落于车尔特格山脉中的一片盆地。当地崎岖的荒野盛产狐狸、貂和兔子等毛皮动物。

english_text: Alebat sits deep in the forests of northeastern Sturgia. This isolated region has long been a refuge for those fleeing oppression or debt or bloodfeud across the northlands, and the dialect is strongly influenced by the tongue of the Vakken woodspeople.
chinese_text: 阿莱巴特坐落于斯特吉亚东北部的森林深处。这片偏远之地长久以来都是北方各地逃离压迫、债务和世仇之人的避难所，当地口音受森林民族瓦尼人的影响非常大。

english_text: Karbur sits at a plateau on the Kachyar Peninsula. Sheltered somewhat by a high ridge to their north, the villagers here raise barley and grain.
chinese_text: 卡布尔坐落于卡恰尔半岛的高原之上，多少受到了北边高耸山脊的一些庇护。当地村民们种植大麦和谷物。

english_text: Zhemyan lies on the ridge that forms the spine of the Kachyar Peninsula. The rich grassy fields of this region make it a prime spot for local landowners to raise horses.
chinese_text: 哲米扬位于卡恰尔半岛北岸。这里草木葱茏，是当地地主饲养马匹的绝佳地点。

english_text: Echarfurd sits on the northern slopes of the Epiric Hills. Unlike most settlements in the kingdom, it was founded by Vlandian migrants, who named it after a settlement in their old homeland. The villagers here grow wheat, finding a ready market in the garrisons stationed nearby.
chinese_text: 埃蒂尔菲德位于巴旦尼亚边界的一个低矮山嘴附近，埃蒂尔河从乌卡利翁地块山崖上的泉水中喷涌而出。当地村民种植小麦，并卖给驻扎在附近的军队。

english_text: Rodetan takes its name from the ruddy, iron-rich soil of this part of the the Biscan Hills. The mines of this district supply the iron ore for many of the forges of the Vlandian kingdom.
chinese_text: 罗德唐之名来源于莱恩诺丘陵富含铁的红土壤。该地区的矿山为瓦兰迪亚王国的许多锻造厂供给铁矿石。

english_text: Mareiven sits in the Vlandian coastal lowlands, beneath the hills of the Rhennod. Villagers harvest the tall trees of the heights, selling the logs to cities on the coast.
chinese_text: 马雷汶坐落于莱恩诺山脉密林覆盖的陡坡之上，俯视着整个奥克斯湖。村民们采伐高大的树木，然后卖到沿海的城市。

english_text: Oritan sits high in the Rhennod, the western escarpment of the Uchalion massif. The families of this region trace their descent to Vlandian mercenaries who intermarried with local hill peoples related to the Battanians.
chinese_text: 一条小河发源于埃博半岛的群山之中，最终汇入奥克斯湖，奥里唐就位于小河旁。水流速度到附近的一个拐角处变缓了，这样村民就可以从河岸掘取陶工所需要的黏土。

english_text: Fregian sits in a shallow valley near Ocs Hall. Villagers plant flax on boggy land that was once a marshy lake before it was drained by the Vlandian barons.
chinese_text: 弗雷吉昂坐落于帕拉汶德北部的平原上，由此开始，瓦兰迪亚的南国暖流让位于北境的寒气。当地村民在沼泽和草地里种植亚麻。

english_text: Marin lies on the edges of the broad valley of the meandering Trand. Misty mornings cooled by sea drifting south and warm afternoons make this land well-suited to the growing of grapes.
chinese_text: 马林位于奥克斯湖以西的缓坡上。向南的洋流令薄雾笼罩的清晨格外凉爽，温暖的下午让当地的葡萄茁壮生长。

english_text: Rulund sits in the windswept coasts north of the Trand River. Although there are few forests in these parts for the pigs to root, they thrive on the rye and wheat grown on the downs by the sea.
chinese_text: 鲁兰德位于特朗中部的林谷中。村民们以橡树林地的橡子为饲料来饲养生猪。

english_text: Palisont sits close to where the Trand River meets the sea. The cool sea air that flows upriver and the warm afternoons allow the growing of wine grapes.
chinese_text: 特朗河北部草绿色的丘陵被一道峻峭的峡谷分割开来，帕利松就坐落于峡谷口处。这一带土壤贫瘠，但从上游吹来的凉爽海风和温暖的午后气候，为酿酒用葡萄的生长提供了良好的条件。

english_text: Furbec sits on a shelf overlooking the rocky Biscan coast of central Vlandia. The climate is warm most of the year, and grapes do well on the slopes of the Biscan Hills.
chinese_text: 菲尔贝克坐落于一块巨岩上，俯瞰着瓦兰迪亚中部嶙峋的比斯坎海岸。当地全年气候温暖，比斯坎山坡上的葡萄长势喜人。

english_text: Savinth sits on a wooded hillside north of the Gulf of Charas. Just down the slope lies fine pasture for the renowned horses of the Vlandians.
chinese_text: 萨万特坐落于沙拉斯湾以北温暖的草原上。这片土地是瓦兰迪亚人公认的优质马场。

english_text: The village of Vesin lies by a creek running down from the Epiric Hills to the Gulf of Charas. This warm land is well-suited to the growing of olive trees.
chinese_text: 韦桑村位于沙拉斯湾的埃皮尔山丘流下来的小溪旁，这片温暖的土地很适合橄榄树的生长。

english_text: Cananc lies in the wet wooded hills of the Ebor Peninsula, where yew trees grow tall in the sea-mists. The village is known for producing fine pigs, who are allowed to range through the thick woods rooting for acorns, chestnuts and grubs. Towering fir and spruce grow on the slopes. This rule of of the Vlandian barons in this rugged land is much lighter than in the south, attracting many migrants who value the relative freedom.
chinese_text: 卡南克位于莱恩诺北部潮湿的林丘中，这个村庄以饲养优质猪而闻名，这些猪能在茂密的森林中穿梭，寻找橡子、栗子和蛴螬。

english_text: Remental sits on a ledge of the Ebor Peninsula, overlooking the sea. Vlandian settlers originally here came to mine silver, but those ores were quickly exhausted. Desperate prospectors were able to locate some deposits of salt, which was much in demand as the coasts here are generally too steep for the creation of salt pans.
chinese_text: 勒芒塔尔在埃伯半岛的群山之中，陡坡上长满了直耸的云杉和冷杉。村民们用陷阱诱捕毛皮兽，如貂、兔子和狐狸。这片荒芜之地近来吸引了许多新的定居者，他们为森林的相对自由而来，瓦兰迪亚贵族在该地的统治也比南方宽松不少。

english_text: Alantas sits in the center of the mountainous Ebor Peninsula. The soil here is thin and the weather here is cold, but rich iron deposits sustain the local economy.
chinese_text: 阿兰塔斯坐落于多山的伊博半岛中央。这里土壤贫瘠、气候寒冷，但丰富的铁矿资源支撑起了本地经济。

english_text: Halisvust was once a bog amid the scrubby coastal woods at the base of the Ebor Peninsula, but Vlandian settlers drained the waters and sowed wheat and rye.
chinese_text: 阿利斯维斯特曾是一片荒芜的沼泽，但瓦兰迪亚定居者们将水排干，在山谷中种起了小麦和黑麦。

english_text: Talivel lies in the middle of the Trand valley in the Vlandian heartland. Villagers plant olives here on the hillsides.
chinese_text: 塔利维尔坐落在瓦兰迪亚腹地的特朗河谷中段。当地村民们在山坡上种植橄榄。

english_text: Revyl, chief town of the rocky Kachyar Peninsula, was a traditional rival of Balgard. According to legend the Balgardian princess Arkina, whose husband had been slain by the Revylians, accepted a proposal from her enemy's king to marry and settle the feud. On her wedding night, however, she barred the door of his hall and burned him and a hundred of his kinsmen and warriors alive inside. The feud has long since been settled by pacts and marriages with happier outcomes, although Revylians still resent the ascent of the Balgardian Gundaroving dynasty.
chinese_text: 雷维尔是怪石嶙峋的卡恰尔半岛上的一座重要城镇，同时也是巴尔加德的传统对手。根据传说，巴尔加德公主阿基娜的丈夫被雷维尔人杀死，但她接受了敌国国王的提议，与其结为连理以解决这一争端。然而，在新婚之夜，她堵住了厅堂的大门，将国王和他的一百名族人与勇士活活烧死在里面。这场争端后来通过一系列的条约和联姻解决了，也迎来了其乐融融的结局，但雷维尔人依旧对巴尔加德扶摇直上的贡达罗夫王朝心怀憎恨。

english_text: Haugr sits on the eastern branch of the Jumne River, where it meanders over its floodplain. It was named after a stone cairn on a riverside bluff, said by locals to have been built by trolls from the nearby tundra. The region produces fine, dark clays, much prized by local potters.
chinese_text: 豪格坐落在朱姆内河的东支流上，河流在泛滥平原上蜿蜒。它的名字源于河岸悬崖上的一堆石头，据当地人说是由附近苔原上的巨魔建造的。这个地区生产精细的深色粘土，深受当地陶工的喜爱。

english_text: Calioc sits in the Neurval, the valley between the Epiric and Biscan Hills. The people of this district grow flax on the wet valley floor.
chinese_text: 卡利奥克坐落于纳尔谷，即埃皮尔丘陵与比斯坎山之间的谷地。该地区的居民在湿润的谷底种植亚麻。

english_text: Galend overlooks the wave-beaten Biscan coast. It takes in the catch from the Biscan's intrepid fishermen and whalers who venture out far into the western ocean, as well as the wool of sheep from the green fog-covered hills. The current line of Vlandian kings comes from the clans who settled in this region during Osric Iron-Arm's invasion.
chinese_text: 加伦遥望着浪蚀的比斯坎海岸。无畏的比斯坎渔民在出航深入西海时，温顺的绵羊在迷雾缭绕的山峦上吃草时，都能瞥见加伦。如今的瓦兰迪亚国王一脉就出自“铁壁”奥斯里克入侵时就定居在这片地区的家族。

english_text: Omrotok sits at the foot of the Sulun Dag mountains, which mark the eastern border of the Devseg plateau. Villagers go to the nearby woods to harvest one of the Devseg's few sources of timber.
chinese_text: 鄂木罗托克坐落于德夫赛格高原东边的速仑山脚下。村民们去附近的树林采伐德夫赛格为数不多的木材。

english_text: Gripsby, on the east coast of Beinland, was founded early in the island's settlement by mainlanders who hunted walrus on nearby beaches. These days they must venture farther afield, to the north of Beinland and the frozen seas beyond, but they still take a rich haul of valuable ivory.
chinese_text: 格里普斯比位于贝恩兰岛的东海岸，是由早期从大陆来到此地并在附近海滩捕猎海象的定居者建立的。如今，他们必须远行，到贝恩兰岛北部和冰冻的海域去捕猎，但他们仍然能够获得丰富的珍贵象牙。

english_text: The village of Nogrent sits high on a ridge overlooking the Biscan coast. Grapes grown here are pressed to make a sturdy wine, a key ingredient in the hearty fishermen's soups for which the Biscan region is famous.
chinese_text: 诺格伦村高踞山脊之上，俯瞰比斯坎海岸。此地种植的葡萄经压榨后酿成醇厚的葡萄酒，正是比斯坎地区闻名遐迩的渔夫浓汤不可或缺的关键原料。

english_text: Karahalli lies in the far north of the Khuzait confederacy, in borderlands contested by Sturgians and Nords. Though the winters are cold, the spring grasses are fine grazing for the local sheep, whose thick wool protects them from the region's piercing winds.
chinese_text: 喀拉哈力位于库赛特部落联盟的极北之地，离冰冷的比亚里海不远，是与斯特吉亚人常年争夺得边境之地。尽管当地几乎终年积雪，但春草仍养活了相当多的绵羊，羊身上产出的厚羊毛帮助人们抵御从海面上刮来的刺骨寒风。

english_text: The fishing village of Aalgrun is known for the eels that thrive in the offshore shallows. Slightly further out to sea fishermen also find herring, as well as char that migrates to the sea from nearby streams to spawn.
chinese_text: 阿尔格伦渔村以在近海浅水区繁衍的鳗鱼而闻名。在稍远的海域，渔民也能捕获鲱鱼，以及从附近溪流迁移到海中产卵的鱼。

english_text: Ormanfard sits at the foot of the Ormanthal, a pass that leads to the Battanian lands. Rains are plentiful and wheat and barley grow well on the hillsides, but villagers are always alert for the sounds of horns from the castle guarding the pass, warning of Battanian raiders.
chinese_text: 奥曼法德坐落在通往巴旦尼亚土地的隘口——奥曼特尔山脚下。这里雨水丰沛，山坡上的小麦和大麦长势良好，但村民们始终警惕着守卫隘口的城堡传来的号角声，那预示着巴旦尼亚掠袭者的来袭。

english_text: The natural fortress of Lycaron sits on a spur jutting out of the great Ornian rock. In the final years of the imperial conquest, the Palaic tribe here negotiated a peaceful federation with the Empire, only to see their home seized by the rebel leader Gethuz. The ensuing siege was only the first of many that Lycaron would undergo in the ensuing centuries, as its nearby silver mines made it a prize for every imperial pretender who ever tried to seize power in a civil war. It is said that the colony of vultures who inhabit the upper reaches of the Rock have dined on the flesh of every people of Calradia.
chinese_text: 吕卡隆这座天然要塞位于巍峨的奥尼石山向外突出的一处缓坡之上。在帝国征服的最后几年，帕拉部落同帝国协商，进行了和平的合邦，结果他们的家园又被叛军首领革图夺走。接踵而至的围城战仅仅是吕卡隆在接下来的几个世纪中屡遭围攻的第一次，因为该城周边有着丰富的银矿脉，任何想在内战中攫取权力的皇位觊觎者都会盯上这里。甚至有人传言，居住在石山顶上的秃鹫已经享用过卡拉迪亚大陆上的每一种民族。

english_text: The frontier city of Danustica has long defended the eastern reaches of the Empire, holding the line against incursions by the Aserai and various Darshi shahs and padishahs further to the east. Many an imperial legionary stationed here has scribbled graffiti on its walls cursing the city's sweltering summers, brackish water and mosquitos, but the inhabitants are proud of their role as border defenders and mock the soldiers wilting in the heat around them.
chinese_text: 边疆城市达努斯提卡主导着卡勒萨——由湖泊和潟湖组成的运输网。它长期以来守卫着边疆，防范阿塞莱人，以及远东达西人的各类沙阿与帕迪沙阿的进犯。许多在此地驻扎的帝国军团士兵都恨不得在墙上刻字，咒骂这座城市炽热的夏日、含盐的水以及从卡勒萨飞来的蚊子。但当地居民却因身肩保疆卫国之责而自豪，并嘲笑身边那些病怏怏的士兵。

english_text: Balgard, which sits on the icy waters of the Byalic Sea, was founded by migrants from the Nordvyg. Legend holds that the initial wave of Nords arrogantly demanded tribute from the nearby Vakken and Sturgian tribes, who formed an alliance and drove the newcomers back to their ships. But the victors fell out over the spoils, until a canny Nord, Gundar, landed and volunteered to help them fairly divvy up the weapons and armor of his dead kinsmen. The residents recognized Gundar's lordship over the region and his descendants, intermarried with the Sturgians, are today the grand princes of Sturgia.
chinese_text: 巴尔加德位于冰冷的马佐波尔湾边，由诺德的移民们建立。根据传说，第一批前来此地的诺德人傲慢地要求附近的瓦肯和斯特吉亚部落纳贡，而后者结成同盟将这群新来者赶回了自己的长船上。然而，胜利者们因为分赃不均爆发了争执，直到一位精明的诺德人贡达尔登陆此地，将自己死去族人的武器和盔甲公平地分给了当地人。当地人认可贡达尔对该地区的统治权，而他的后代和斯特吉亚人不断通婚，成为了如今斯特吉亚的列位王公。

english_text: The village of Draugmyr takes its name from a nearby bog that was once a place of sacrifice. Though long since drained to create farmland, its rich wheatfields still turn up the odd bone or golden grave-offering.
chinese_text: 德赖于格米尔村的名字来源于附近曾经是祭祀场所的沼泽。尽管这片沼泽早已被排干并开垦成农田，但其肥沃的麦田至今仍偶尔会出土一些骨骼或金色的墓葬祭品。

english_text: Marathea lies in a valley in the Dryatic Mountains, overlooking Lake Laconis. The villagers are skilled miners, and the red streaks running down the nearby cliffsides are evidence of rich iron ores.
chinese_text: 马拉忒亚位于德律亚山麓的一处山谷中，俯瞰着拉科尼斯湖。村民们是技艺高超的矿工，附近悬崖上的红色条纹便是富含铁矿的证据。

english_text: Laxahof sits on a low promontory that juts into the Byalic Sea, on the war-torn marches that divide the Sturgian and Nordic lands. In past generations its inhabitants made their living by signing on to dangerous, freezing whaling ventures organized by Byalic Sea merchants. Rrecently they have begun to organize their own voyages, bringing home wealth to what was once one of the poorest corners of the north.
chinese_text: 拉萨霍夫坐落在一个低矮的海角上，它伸入比亚里海，位于饱受战火蹂躏的边境地带，将斯特吉亚和北境之地分隔开来。在过去几代人中，这里的居民通过参与比亚里海商人组织的危险而寒冷的捕鲸活动谋生。最近，他们开始组织自己的航程，为这片曾是北方最贫瘠的角落之一带来了财富。

english_text: The village of Bjorenbyr on the downs of western Beinland was founded only two generations ago, as the people of Beinland began to settle inland. It harvests the old-growth forests of the highlands, where great trees might still be found, and are much valued by shipbuilders on the coast and the mainland.
chinese_text: 位于贝恩兰西部丘陵地带的比约伦比尔村，仅在两代人之前才建立起来，当时贝恩兰人开始向内陆迁徙定居。该村落开采高地的原始森林资源，那里仍可寻获参天古木，深受沿海及大陆地区造船工匠的珍视。

english_text: Vostrum was founded by the Calradian mercenary Archacos, one of a number of rogue commanders who broke away from the Empire during its expansion. Unlike some, who tried to reproduce the Empire's republican heritage, he chose to rule as a god-king. His dynasty lasted for generations, until imperial troops overran it and smashed every haloed statue of Archacos and his successors into rubble. Even today, western and northern imperial senators accuse families from this region of being closet monarchists.
chinese_text: 沃斯特鲁姆由卡拉德佣兵阿耳卡科斯建立，此人是帝国扩张时期背离帝国的数名叛逃指挥官之一。和其他人希望重现帝国的共和传统不同，他选择成为一名神王进行统治。他的家系延续了数代，直到帝国的士兵推翻了该政权，并将每一座阿耳卡科斯及其继承者的神化雕像推倒并砸碎。直到如今，来自西部和北部的帝国元老都会控告该地区的家族是潜在的君主主义者。

english_text: Amprela is the foremost town of the northeastern Empire. Watchmen stand atop its towers, looking out for beacons from the frontier fortresses to the north and east that might signal the approach of enemies. Horse archers recruited from the rough Eleftheroi freemen drink in the barracks, waiting for the order to ride out against Khuzait steppe-riders, Sturgian woodsmen or Nord longships coming down the Caracasos River, while the cataphracts drill in the courtyard of the keep and ensure their horses are in fighting trim should the archon need to assemble an army to deal with any larger threat.
chinese_text: 安普雷拉位于帝国的极北之境。看守们屹立于高塔之上，时刻注视着北方、东方或者西方的边境要塞发出的信号，警告掠袭者的到来。兵营中驻扎着由散漫的“自由民”组成的马弓手，随时等待命令出击对抗草原的骑兵。而具装骑兵们则在城市的大门集结，同斯特吉亚的王公们争夺伊勒坦运输线——一个由周边的湖泊组成的运输网络——的贸易控制权。

english_text: Nordic tribes pushing into the dark forests to their east founded the citadel of Hargard several generations ago. It overlooks the river that the Nords call the Jumne, probably a derivation of a Sturgian term for the mysterious burial pits found along its banks. Today, the river forms the main artery of transportation for the Nord kingdom's eastern domains, a meeting-place of Nords, Vakken, Sturgians, and even some forest-dwelling cousins of the steppe tribes, all harvesting the wealth of the river-valley to sell to the peoples of the south.
chinese_text: 数代以前，诺德部落向东推进至茂密的森林深处，建立了阿加尔要塞。这座要塞俯瞰着被诺德人称为朱姆内的河流——该名称很可能源自斯特吉亚人对沿岸神秘葬坑的称谓。如今，这条河流已成为诺德王国东部领地的主要运输动脉，汇聚了诺德人、瓦肯人、斯特吉亚人，甚至还有草原部落的森林远亲。各族在此采集河谷汇聚的财富，销往南方诸族。

english_text: Hvalvik is the main port on the remote northern island known to the Nords as Beinland, the land of bones. It is debated whether the island's namesake comes from the walrus ivory that drew hunters here, or the only trace that many left behind, buried in shallow graves alongside its bleak gravel-covered shores. In the last few generations, however, a run of milder winters and a growing mainland population has encouraged colonists to seek their fortune in Beinland, and the former cluster of whalers' huts known as Hvalvik is now a thriving town.
chinese_text: 瓦尔维克是北方偏远岛屿上的主要港口，诺德人称之为贝恩兰，即“骸骨之地”。关于岛屿名称的由来存在争议：是因吸引猎人前来的海象象牙，还是因许多人在荒芜的砾石海岸边留下的唯一痕迹——那些埋于浅坟中的骸骨。然而近几代以来，较为温和的冬季与大陆人口的不断增长，促使殖民者前往贝恩兰寻求财富。昔日的捕鲸人棚屋聚集地瓦尔维克，如今已发展成为繁荣的城镇。

english_text: Montos sits near the headwaters of the Aminys River, close to the Battanian frontier. The farmers here keep a watchful eye when tending their hillside fields, always looking for raiding parties coming westward from the valley of the Miron River to their east.
chinese_text: 蒙托斯位于阿米尼斯河的源头附近，靠近巴丹尼亚边境。这里的农民在耕作山坡上的田地时总是警惕地观察周围，时刻防备着来自东边弥隆河谷的掠袭部队向西进犯。
